suggestion.reason: Stops wasted generation after cancelling OpenCode commit messages, titles and similar text generation.

suggestion.question: Does f5 ship the native hyprland-snap-shot helper, or should SnapShot be treated as upstream-only?
suggestion.reason: Desktop visual fix, relevant only if f5 ships the native Hyprland SnapShot helper.

topics.summary: Reattaches the buffer on viewport commits so Hyprland 0.56.2 applies the new surface size.
topics.title: Remove oversized bars from Hyprland SnapShot animations

suggestion.reason: This fixes a desktop SnapShot bug. Earlier groups in this run (hyprland-snapshot, snapshot-gnome-51) suggest f5 ships SnapShot.

topics.title: SnapShot setup on Hyprland accepts its own unchanged Lua shortcut

suggestion.reason: Fixes double-counted usage in f5's usage surface.

topics.summary: The composer usage report groups native provider instances that share a subscription account. It prefers usable data, then the freshest snapshot, and keeps the freshest reset-credit balance. Different known workspaces stay separate.
topics.title: Composer usage report merges native instances of the same subscription

suggestion.reason: It replaces an unexplained timeout with an actionable error for local Tailscale pairing.

topics.summary: When tailscale status shows the HTTPS capability is disabled, pairing fails right away with a message that points to the Tailscale admin DNS settings.
topics.title: pair --tailscale explains a disabled tailnet Serve instead of timing out

suggestion.reason: Fixes opening PRs in f5's PR hub for Azure DevOps and GitLab forges.

topics.summary: Repository-only PR URLs are matched to projects with the provider-native repository selector and case-insensitive host matching. Azure DevOps and nested GitLab PRs open their detail panel.
topics.title: Azure DevOps and nested GitLab PR links open in the panel

topics.reason: Only affects T3 Connect relay authorization.

suggestion.reason: Only affects T3 Connect relay authorization.

topics.summary: Relay authorization returns a transient session-pending error while the cloud session is loading, instead of a blocking sessionChanged error.
topics.title: A loading T3 Connect session is no longer reported as a sign-in change

suggestion.reason: f5 ships desktop SnapShot, so the same rapid-repeat bug can happen there.

topics.summary: Repeated SnapShot shortcuts are dropped while a capture animation is running, so they no longer tear down the overlay and start a new renderer. New captures are accepted again as soon as the animation lands.
topics.title: SnapShot ignores repeated shortcut presses while the capture animates

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost edits in keybinding settings.

topics.summary: Keybinding rows use a stable id built from command, shortcut and condition instead of their list position, so saving one row no longer resets the drafts in sibling rows.
topics.title: Saving one keybinding keeps unsaved edits in the others

suggestion.reason: A small sidebar layout fix.

topics.summary: The status slot reserves space for both the status and the actions, so the pin and Woke label stay in place on hover.
topics.title: Pinned thread marker no longer moves when hovering a sidebar row
fix(mobile): sheet action buttons text alignment (#11260)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a server startup hang in shared shell code that f5 has.

topics.summary: The -ilc environment probe runs detached, with stdin and stderr ignored, so a controlling TTY owned by another process group cannot stop it. Before, server startup could block past the timeout.
topics.title: Login-shell environment probe can no longer be stopped by job control

suggestion.reason: Desktop SnapShot fix. Other SnapShot fixes are already being ported.

topics.summary: Window matching accepts Chrome's browser and profile title suffix, but only for windows from the captured PID, so accessibility text is included in SnapShots of Chrome.
topics.title: macOS SnapShots of Chrome include the app's text

suggestion.reason: Improves checkpoint error clarity. Needs reimplementing in f5's checkpoint layer.

topics.summary: When checkpoint rollback fails because of a held index.lock, the user sees a specific, actionable message instead of a generic error.
topics.title: A rollback blocked by Git's index lock says so

suggestion.reason: Fixes worktree creation being reported as failed in f5's git layer.

topics.summary: The optional gh-merge-base config write is best effort. A held config.lock logs a warning and still returns the created checkout.
topics.title: Worktree creation succeeds when git config is locked

suggestion.reason: Fixes favorites that were hidden in the model picker.

topics.summary: Legacy models that are favorited stay in the provider's main list instead of being hidden in the collapsed legacy section.
topics.title: Favorited legacy models show in the model picker's main list

topics.reason: Relay and iOS Live Activity behavior only.

suggestion.reason: Relay and iOS Live Activity behavior only.

topics.summary: The relay cron ends idle iOS Live Activities, and settling a finished thread republishes awareness so its row is removed.
topics.title: Live Activity cleanup for idle and settled threads

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing Claude usage for proxy users, if f5 has the CLIProxyAPI usage source.

topics.summary: The forwarded Claude OAuth usage request adds User-Agent claude-code/2.1.273, so the upstream no longer returns 429 and Claude windows show in Limits.
topics.title: Claude usage through CLIProxyAPI sends a Claude Code user agent

suggestion.question: Does f5 ship the cloud boot-service installer (apps/server/src/cloud/bootService) for running the server as a system service?
suggestion.reason: Lives in the server's cloud boot service, which supports T3 Connect hosting. f5 likely has no equivalent.

topics.summary: Service install always writes the restart-pending marker before replacing files. A failed activation stays non-current and can be retried.
topics.title: A failed service start no longer looks current

suggestion.reason: PR hub UX improvement. Reimplement outside the source-control-* packages, and skip the GitCafe part.

topics.summary: After the newest run of each check is picked, failed and cancelled checks sort first and provider order is kept within each group. This covers GitHub, Forgejo and Bitbucket.
topics.title: Failed and cancelled PR checks are listed first

suggestion.reason: Windows users get no thread notifications without this fix.

topics.summary: Notification tags hash the environment and thread identity into a stable 16-character tag, because Windows dropped toasts with 73-character tags.
topics.title: Thread notifications show on Windows

suggestion.reason: Startup reliability fix for f5's server, which has the same raw Node HTTP boundary.

topics.summary: Requests and upgrades that arrive after the server starts listening but before the Effect handlers attach get 503 with Retry-After: 1. The temporary handlers are removed once serving begins.
topics.title: Server answers early requests with 503 instead of hanging

suggestion.reason: Imported threads now get correct titles.

topics.summary: The session scanner tracks customTitle separately from aiTitle, so a rename survives later AI-title flushes. An empty customTitle clears the rename.
topics.title: Imported Claude sessions keep user renames

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for shutdown hangs and orphaned processes.

topics.summary: ProcessRunner, Claude text generation and Codex exec/MCP preflight escalate to a forced kill 1 s after SIGTERM, so shutdown and timeouts no longer hang.
topics.title: Helper processes are force-killed so they can't outlive the backend

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible desktop notification bug in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: A sender-checked IPC asks the Electron main process to restore and focus the window before the thread opens.
topics.title: Clicking a thread notification raises the desktop window

suggestion.reason: PR hub bug fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The resolver rejects context lines outside the host's hunks and keeps the selected side. GitHub no longer rejects a whole review because one comment sits in expanded context.
topics.title: PR review comments stay inside the pull request's hunks

suggestion.reason: f5 builds desktop artifacts with this script, so a mismatched bundled version would affect its builds too.

topics.summary: The artifact build passes the resolved version to compilation through APP_VERSION and restores changed manifests afterward. A checkout lock keeps concurrent builds from mixing versions.
topics.title: Desktop artifacts bundle a client and server with the artifact version

suggestion.reason: A visual fix in the composer, a surface f5 has. Port it if f5's composer has the same banner-and-toolbar mask layout.

topics.summary: The bottom toolbar's backdrop mask now starts 1px higher, using a --spacing-composer-seam token. Scrolling text no longer shows through a thin gap when a banner is attached and the composer is collapsed.
topics.title: No gap between the composer and its bottom toolbar

suggestion.reason: Fixes SnapShot capturing the wrong window on macOS.

topics.summary: The window lookup picks the first visible layer-zero window and skips transparent windows and thin untitled helper strips.
topics.title: macOS SnapShot skips auxiliary browser helper windows

suggestion.reason: Fixes sidebar grouping of unrelated repos, which can happen in f5's project grouping.

topics.summary: Repository identity now ignores remotes whose URL is a local path (., file://, a drive path and similar). Unrelated repos, such as GitButler's gb-local, no longer merge into one sidebar project group.
topics.title: Repos with only a local git remote are no longer grouped together

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug where turning off fetching was not respected, which f5's VCS status broadcaster can also hit. Keep f5's autoPullDefaultBranch default.

topics.summary: The status broadcaster resolves the current fetch interval for all callers. At zero it skips the upstream fetch and automatic pull, including on focus refreshes and worktree handoff. Local status and PR lookup still refresh.
topics.title: A zero Git fetch interval also stops fetch and auto-pull on window focus

suggestion.reason: This fixes terminal clipboard and multiplexer misbehavior.

topics.summary: TMUX, TMUX_PANE, STY, WINDOW, ZELLIJ, ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME and ZELLIJ_PANE_ID are added to the terminal environment blocklist, so tools no longer act on the pane that launched the server.
topics.title: Integrated terminals don't inherit tmux, screen or Zellij variables

suggestion.reason: A small layout fix in the composer tasks panel.

topics.summary: The duration column uses min-w-12 and whitespace-nowrap, so it grows for long values instead of wrapping.
topics.title: Task durations over an hour no longer wrap in the tasks panel

suggestion.reason: Fixes a mismatch between what Settings displays and what the composer actually uses.

topics.summary: When the saved default model is hidden, Settings resolves it to the effective fallback model and that model's traits. Before, it showed the fallback model's name together with the hidden model's traits.
topics.title: Settings shows the model a hidden default falls back to

suggestion.reason: Fixes checkpoint failures on Windows, which f5 can hit.

topics.summary: On Windows, the checkpoint capture, recovery and restore git commands pass -c core.longpaths=true.
topics.title: Checkpoints work in Windows workspaces with paths over 260 characters

suggestion.reason: Fixes panel focus being taken away in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Proactive panel requests leave existing non-diff tabs alone, and a linked PR is followed only when it changes. Linked PRs are remembered per visited thread.
topics.title: Returning to a thread no longer jumps to its pull request tab

suggestion.reason: Small layout fix in a composer surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The branch toolbar overflow check subtracts inline padding, so branch labels collapse correctly at narrow widths.
topics.title: Composer context strip subtracts its padding when measuring space

suggestion.reason: This fixes a preview browser bug that blanks tabs and breaks automation.

topics.summary: ElectronBrowserHost renders webviews in a fixed order sorted by runtime tab id, so React never moves a webview element. Moving it destroyed the Electron guest and left a white page.
topics.title: Preview tabs no longer go blank when the tab list reorders

suggestion.reason: PR hub UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Turn completion triggers a background refresh that keeps unchanged diff pages, instead of a hard reset that unmounted the viewer and jumped to the top.
topics.title: PR Code tab keeps its scroll when a turn finishes

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: Patches react-native-image-viewing so it uses the current window size.
topics.title: Android image previews resize with the window

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost user input in the pending-question panel, which f5 has. Reimplement in f5's pending-request hook.

topics.summary: Answers, selections and the current question position for a pending question are kept for the browser tab, scoped by environment, thread and request. Opening New thread or Settings and coming back no longer clears a typed answer.
topics.title: Typed answers to pending questions survive leaving and returning to a thread

suggestion.reason: This is a terminal UX improvement for project scripts and worktree setup.

topics.summary: Project actions and worktree setup or settle scripts are typed with a leading space, so shells that ignore space-prefixed commands leave them out of history. The shared helper is projectScriptTerminalInput.
topics.title: Project script commands stay out of shell history

suggestion.reason: Small UX fix in the Files panel.

topics.summary: While matching rows are visible, the Loading files status is screen-reader only, so a pending search no longer moves rows by 24px.
topics.title: Loading no longer shifts the Files tree

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop UX bug where a misclick quits the app and stops running agents.

topics.summary: On Windows and Linux, the media dialog now lays out below the native titlebar strip using a --native-titlebar-height variable. The image viewer's X no longer sits next to the window's Close button, so a misclick no longer quits the app.
topics.title: Image viewer close button stays clear of the window controls
fix(mobile): preserve Home row content across recycling (#14004)

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong preview viewport sizes in f5's preview browser when the desktop app is zoomed.

topics.summary: Electron webviews are sized by the ratio of guest zoom to host zoom. Toolbar sizing, agent cursors, fitted previews and the mini-player use the same units. Window zoom is exposed through preload.
topics.title: Preview viewports keep their size when the main window is zoomed

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop file-reveal UX gap that also exists in f5's external launcher on Linux.

topics.summary: Linux reveal first calls org.freedesktop.FileManager1.ShowItems through gdbus with an escaped file URI, so the file manager selects the file. If the helper is missing, refuses or stalls (2s deadline), it falls back to opening the folder.
topics.title: Reveal in Files selects the file on Linux

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong worktree paths in branch selection for repos with a separate git dir. f5's git driver can show the same symptom.

topics.summary: The refs snapshot leaves out the Git common directory from worktree entries. The current branch falls back to the opened checkout, so branch selection shows the folder the user opened.
topics.title: A separate git dir is no longer reported as a branch's worktree

suggestion.reason: Server and desktop reliability fix for packaged asset hosting.

topics.summary: When opening a handle returns NotFound for a file that can be read, such as an Electron asar asset, the server reads the bytes in full and serves them with an accurate Content-Length.
topics.title: Static files are served when the platform cannot open file handles

suggestion.reason: The background service launcher in apps/server/src/cloud is part of upstream's cloud and service stack, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: resolveStartup reads T3_SERVICE_LAUNCHER_CONTEXT only when an IPC channel is connected. A context inherited by terminal shells no longer breaks t3 serve.
topics.title: t3 run from a T3 terminal ignores the inherited service launcher context
fix(mobile): load iOS device streams over HTTP on Android (#14284)

suggestion.reason: Provider update bug fix.

topics.summary: Update pins the advertised stable version instead of @latest, which pnpm's minimumReleaseAge could resolve to an older release.
topics.title: pnpm-global provider updates install the advertised version

suggestion.reason: Fixes a layout bug on f5's usage page.

topics.summary: The breakdown table uses natural column sizing inside a labeled, keyboard-accessible horizontal scroll region.
topics.title: Usage Day and Hour breakdown columns no longer overlap

suggestion.reason: It fixes stale models in the picker after a provider update, in a provider subsystem f5 has.

topics.summary: After a provider CLI update, the registry refreshes the model manifest and clears the discovery and latest-version caches. It then probes every enabled instance of that provider, so new models appear for every account.
topics.title: Provider discovery refreshes after a CLI update

suggestion.reason: Fixes duplicate list numbers in the composer.

topics.summary: When an item is inserted into a numbered list with rich text off, the following sibling items are renumbered. Nested content, chips and zero padding are kept, and the caret stays in the new item.
topics.title: Continuing a numbered list in the plain-Markdown composer renumbers the items below

suggestion.reason: This reliability fix applies to f5's processRunner, which still exists. A missing command probe can otherwise crash the connection.

topics.summary: ProcessRunner turns spawn errors that Node throws synchronously (ENOTDIR from a PATH entry that is a file) into ProcessSpawnError. Callers that already recover from spawn failures no longer let a defect bring down the environment connection.
topics.title: Synchronous spawn failures such as ENOTDIR become ProcessSpawnError instead of defects

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in the preview browser picker, if the fork's picker numbers annotations with a counter.

topics.summary: Annotation ids now include a random part chosen once per page load. Before, ids were reused after a reload and overwrote earlier annotations in the draft.
topics.title: Preview annotations no longer replace each other after a reload

suggestion.reason: This is a reliability fix for CLI service updates and restarts, which f5 also ships. The T3 Connect onboarding message changes do not apply to f5.

topics.summary: When the T3 service is the caller's ancestor, restart is queued with systemctl --user restart --no-block, and install runs as a separate transient unit. The update no longer stops its own caller before the service starts again.
topics.title: t3 update and service restart run from a T3 terminal no longer leave the service stopped

suggestion.reason: A small visual fix in the terminal and timeline, both of which f5 has.

topics.summary: The bottom terminal drawer gets z-45, so a tall timeline minimap no longer draws on top of the terminal in long threads.
topics.title: Terminal drawer covers the turn minimap

suggestion.reason: This fixes checkpoint capture failures on macOS network mounts.

topics.summary: On macOS, a checkpoint git command that fails because the full flush is unsupported is retried once with core.fsyncMethod=writeout-only. Unrelated errors still fail.
topics.title: Checkpoints retry with plain fsync on mounts that reject F_FULLFSYNC

suggestion.reason: Affects only the built-in relay tracer.

topics.title: Relay tracing honors telemetry opt-out

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop regression after Linux updates.

topics.summary: The last explicit device scale factor is saved to a state file and restored before Electron is ready when no switch is passed.
topics.title: Linux keeps --force-device-scale-factor across AppImage updates

suggestion.reason: Fixes how the Claude provider displays and sends its default.

topics.summary: The manifest now marks thinking as on by default for Haiku 4.5. Text generation sends a thinking setting only when the user explicitly chose one.
topics.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 shows thinking on by default

suggestion.reason: A desktop Linux fix for the app icon. f5 ships a desktop app.

topics.summary: When the desktop app registers its URL handler, it installs icons under both the lowercase and the exact-case app id in the user's hicolor theme. Docks that look up the Wayland app id then show the app's icon instead of a generic one.
topics.title: Linux installs theme icons named after the app id

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement to f5's usage surface.

topics.summary: Pooled usage bars add the per-account even-pace tick and an accessible pace description, using the shared calculation. Only the web part applies to f5.

suggestion.reason: Fixes a provider-instance display bug in the web sidebar and pickers.

suggestion.reason: Applies only to the T3 Connect relay.

suggestion.reason: Forge support fix in the PR hub, which f5 has.

suggestion.reason: A build-script change to generated license notices, with no product behavior change.
