topics.title: Queued shell updates are coalesced for slow clients

suggestion.reason: Fixes threads quietly sending on a stale branch in worktrees, which is a git/worktree surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The branch-change notice now covers worktree threads too. The next send uses the branch actually checked out and keeps the worktree attached. Worktrees do not offer Restore branch, because switching one could affect sibling threads.
topics.title: Worktree threads warn when their checkout branch changes

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for pending questions. It must be reimplemented in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: Answers to user_input requests are checked before the request resolves. Codex-style {answers} values are unwrapped. Malformed answers are rejected and the request stays pending, so the caller can send a corrected answer.
topics.title: Unusable user-input answers are rejected before the request resolves

suggestion.reason: Fixes thread snooze behavior. Reimplement it in f5's orchestrator and client state.

topics.summary: Every snooze now sets snoozedAt to the current time, even when the wake time is unchanged. A thread woken by a failure or completion goes back into snooze with the same preset.
topics.title: Re-snoozing a woken thread to the same wake time hides it again

suggestion.reason: The checkpoint failure on every turn can happen in f5. Reimplement it in f5's checkpoint layer, because upstream's orchestration-v2 doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: When a project folder sits inside a Git repo that ignores it, checkpoint capture now reports unsupported instead of failing on every turn. Tracked files inside are still captured, and unrelated staged changes stay out.
topics.title: Checkpoints skip a project folder its parent repo ignores

suggestion.reason: Fixes an error when opening projects on machines without Git.

topics.summary: In the Git worktree probe, a missing git executable now maps to 'not a repository'. Other spawn failures still propagate.
topics.title: Opening a folder without Git installed no longer shows a spawn error

suggestion.reason: PR hub fix. Reimplement without client-runtime routing, which does not exist in f5.

topics.summary: Viewed-file writes bump the viewed epoch even when they fail, and the web refreshes after an error. Files GitHub did mark as viewed show correctly.
topics.title: PR viewed files refresh after a partially failed batch

suggestion.reason: Fixes preview tabs that disappear and lose their zoom and history state.

topics.summary: Preview session sync ignores waiting or stale list results, so background tabs and their desktop state are no longer dropped when the Browser panel reopens.
topics.title: Known preview tabs stay visible while the session list refreshes

suggestion.reason: Bug fix in modelSelection.ts present in fork; saved models beyond 32 silently resolve wrong.

topics.summary: Removes MAX_CUSTOM_MODEL_COUNT cap in normalizeCustomModelEntries so picker and resolution match Settings.
topics.title: Model picker offers all saved custom models, not first 32

suggestion.reason: Dark-mode visibility fix in the shared Switch component, which f5 has. The EnvironmentRow part only applies where an equivalent row exists.

topics.summary: In dark mode, an unchecked Switch thumb now uses muted-foreground instead of the page background. The environment row dims only its identity, not its controls, so a switch that is off no longer looks disabled.
topics.title: Switched-off toggles stay visible in dark mode

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing or stale error details in the PR hub.

topics.summary: PR handoffs use the failure returned by the current attempt instead of stale action state. A shared formatter keeps the server's recovery text and the git failure reason.
topics.title: Pull request checkout failures show the current attempt's error detail

suggestion.reason: Fixes terminal input bugs in f5's Ghostty terminal.

topics.summary: Only keys whose presses were encoded emit Kitty release events. A keyed pane tree keeps the original surface through split and unsplit.
topics.title: Terminal no longer sends key releases for app-handled shortcuts

suggestion.reason: Fixes timeline and composer layout on reopened threads.

topics.summary: The overflow check uses the unmeasured last row's top position as a lower bound, so the composer settles into its scrolled state.
topics.title: Composer collapses when a thread opens above its end

suggestion.reason: Upstream analytics infrastructure.

topics.summary: Changes the default PostHog host to T3's ingest proxy, adds a release-channel stamp, and slows the flush interval.
topics.title: Telemetry is sent through ingest.t3.codes

suggestion.reason: Data-loss bug in PR checkout. f5 has the equivalent git and PR flow, so this belongs in f5's git layer.

topics.summary: Local PR checkout refuses when there are tracked edits and uses an unforced checkout that only fast-forwards. The result is checked against the provider head, with a warning when that head can't be confirmed.
topics.title: Check out here no longer discards local pull request work

suggestion.reason: This fixes a desktop startup failure on hosts without IPv6.

topics.summary: The port availability probe treats EAFNOSUPPORT like EADDRNOTAVAIL, so desktop startup no longer rejects every free port on hosts without IPv6.
topics.title: Port checks work on hosts with IPv6 disabled

suggestion.reason: Saved connections could stay disconnected after the host became compatible again. Needs reimplementing in f5's connection layer, since client-runtime does not exist here.

topics.summary: A protocol mismatch now pauses the environment instead of saving it as switched off. Clearing the block reconnects environments that were enabled. Environments the user disabled stay off.
topics.title: Incompatible hosts no longer switch environments off permanently

suggestion.reason: Network reliability fix that affects outbound fetches such as the provider registry.

topics.summary: The CLI raises Node's autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout, so a slow IPv4 connect is not abandoned when IPv6 is advertised but unroutable. Before, the ACP Registry fetch failed.
topics.title: ACP Registry loads on networks with slow IPv4 connects
fix(mobile): open pending tasks from the iPad sidebar (#15083)

suggestion.reason: Applies to saved remote environments and the client-runtime connection registry, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Turning a saved environment back on clears the cached unsupported state and retries the handshake.
topics.title: Re-enabling a saved direct connection retries a cached compatibility rejection

suggestion.reason: Fixes usage limits that look complete after a failed probe. f5 has the same usage subsystem; reimplement in f5's provider usage layer.

topics.summary: Sparse usage-limit updates keep the probeFailed marker, including when no snapshot exists yet. Unchanged updates keep the same snapshot object, so token-usage ticks don't republish it. Applies to Claude and Codex.
topics.title: A mid-turn usage update no longer hides a failed limits probe

suggestion.reason: A sidebar UX fix. f5 has subagent threads.

topics.summary: An open subagent is represented by its nearest ancestor that has a sidebar row. That row stays highlighted and anchors search and next/previous navigation.
topics.title: Sidebar keeps the parent thread highlighted while a subagent is open

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost prompt text for Claude skills in the composer.

topics.summary: A skill chip after other text sends the full request, with mentions written as /name, before the final command block. The model no longer loses the rest of the prompt.
topics.title: Claude skill chips placed mid-sentence keep the whole request

suggestion.reason: Subagent completion wakes exist in f5. Reimplement the Stop fix in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: Stop disposes both the incoming completion cohort and the cohort of tasks delegated during the wake, so a late child completion no longer wakes the thread again.
topics.title: Stopping a completion-wake run also stops tasks delegated during it

suggestion.reason: A small visual fix in the PR hub.

topics.summary: Comment, review and resolved headers in the PR summary align by text baseline. The fix button's manual offset is removed.
topics.title: Pull request comment headers align on the text baseline

suggestion.reason: Visible fix for Pi provider timeline notices.

topics.summary: Pi notify events become visible system notices instead of folded notify tool calls. Notification and extension-error ids include the provider turn id, so threads no longer overwrite each other's notices.
topics.title: Pi extension notifications render as notices with distinct ids

suggestion.reason: Fixes ACP handshakes in effect-acp, which the fork shares.

topics.summary: Typed RPC request ids no longer start at 2**32. They now start from a constant that fits in Int32, so Kotlin ACP SDK agents such as Junie can initialize.
topics.title: ACP request ids stay within signed 32-bit so Kotlin agents respond

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong change totals in f5 for branches that track a non-primary remote.

topics.summary: The base resolves the branch's qualified remote-tracking ref before falling back to the primary remote. A lagging fork origin no longer adds commits that are already upstream to Changes or review previews.
topics.title: Changes compare the default branch with its tracking upstream

suggestion.reason: Forge fix for PR linking. Reimplement inside f5's GitLab forge layer, since source-control-* packages don't exist.

topics.summary: Confirms a remote's host through glab auth so self-hosted GitLab without 'gitlab' in its hostname is identified. Also normalizes userless SCP remotes without mistaking Windows drive paths for hosts.
topics.title: Self-hosted GitLab projects resolve bare pull request numbers

suggestion.reason: Observability improvement in the desktop backend manager.

topics.summary: A backend killed by a signal is logged as 'killed by SIGKILL' in the output log and restart event, instead of an exit-status read error.
topics.title: Desktop backend exit logs name the killing signal

suggestion.reason: Thread status fix; reimplement in f5's layers, since orchestration-v2 and client-runtime don't exist here.

topics.summary: Pending request summaries carry a blocking flag. Thread status and agent awareness keep showing Working during live work when the pending question is nonblocking, and switch to Input when the work ends.
topics.title: Nonblocking async questions keep a running thread Working

suggestion.reason: Reverted upstream in #22152.

topics.summary: This added MCP tools for reading thread diffs, answering pending approvals and mark_read. Upstream reverted it for widening the permission boundary.
topics.title: MCP agents inspect thread diffs and answer approvals (reverted)

suggestion.reason: Mostly changes upstream's context-handoff lifecycle row and mobile; f5 lacks that subsystem.

topics.summary: Pending and persisted handoff rows use account badges on both endpoints, so a handoff between accounts on the same model is visible. The web icon takes over the compact size used by sidebar rows.
topics.title: Handoffs between accounts show each side's account badge

suggestion.reason: Fixes extension models missing from the Pi model picker.

topics.summary: The Pi RPC discovery timeout goes from 15 s to 30 s, so extension models still appear when Pi starts slowly.
topics.title: Pi model discovery gets 30 seconds on cold start

suggestion.reason: Composer and desktop UX fix for SnapShot, which f5 has.

topics.summary: A capture pins the open question and goes into its attachment draft. It falls back to the thread draft if the question closed, and respects the attachment limit.
topics.title: SnapShots taken during an open question attach to that question

suggestion.reason: Fixes a settings inconsistency on the Usage page.

topics.summary: Past-24h chart axes, hover labels, range header, breakdown and model dialog respect the 12-hour, 24-hour or system time format.
topics.title: Usage hourly labels follow the Time format setting

suggestion.reason: A sidebar status bug that can happen in f5. Reimplement inside f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: The first non-maintenance dispatch sets a null visit watermark to 1 ms before dispatch, so the completion counts as unread. Imported history stays read.
topics.title: Never-opened background threads show as unread when they finish

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading Codex model option display in f5's provider picker.

topics.summary: The provider reads Codex's global service tier (bounded to 3 s) and applies it as the default for models that advertise it. Before, the picker showed Standard while Codex ran Fast.
topics.title: Codex model options show a service tier inherited from global config

suggestion.reason: Gives f5's Antigravity provider an actionable installation failure message instead of a generic one.

topics.summary: ACP process exits keep their signal and stderr enrichment. Antigravity installation recognizes the IPv6 loopback diagnostic and shows fixed guidance, and Google sign-in URLs are redacted.
topics.title: Antigravity install explains IPv6 loopback startup failures

suggestion.reason: Prevents choosing a raw address that skips the alias's SSH settings.

topics.summary: Discovery hides raw known-host addresses that match a configured alias's HostName, and hostname searches now find aliases.
topics.title: SSH host suggestions no longer duplicate configured aliases

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement that shows existing compaction progress. It adds no automatic compaction, so the declined compaction items do not apply.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter publishes a running compaction item and settles that same item when it ends. The web treats a running compaction as active, so follow-ups queue during automatic compaction, for Codex too.
topics.title: Claude automatic compaction shows as running while it happens

suggestion.reason: Prevents duplicate imported threads. Reimplement in f5's importer and event sink.

topics.summary: Inside the publish transaction, the importer checks whether another thread, including archived or deleted ones, owns the native Codex or Claude session. If so, it no longer creates a duplicate thread. Missing runtime metadata is recovered on retry.
topics.title: Bulk import skips native sessions that another thread already owns

suggestion.reason: Only matters when grouped projects span several environments.

topics.summary: The picker lists each physical checkout, with connected ones first and offline ones shown with their status. Picking one pins the draft to that environment.
topics.title: New-thread picker lists each repository checkout across environments

suggestion.reason: It fixes a visible bug in SnapShot, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The SnapShot coordinator drains pending captures only while the setting is on, so disabled SnapShots no longer replay capture sounds or error toasts on focus. Each capture or failure kind gets one sound and one notification.
topics.title: Disabled SnapShots stop retrying captures and playing sounds

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing Claude skills in the composer.

topics.summary: Discovery reads the installed plugin inventory and merged enablement settings, and lists namespaced plugin skills. Existing scope precedence is kept.
topics.title: Skills from enabled Claude plugins appear in the skill picker

suggestion.reason: Provider UX fix for OpenCode, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: session.retry.scheduled updates one provider retry row, which settles on recovery, failure or interruption. Pending retries are restored after a reconnect.
topics.title: OpenCode 2 turns show provider retries
fix(mobile): avoid nested dropdowns for single tools (#15674)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a UI flicker in the PR detail panel.

topics.summary: The condensed-header compensation saves an absolute scroll target instead of a delta, so a scroll position the browser already clamped is not adjusted twice.
topics.title: PR header no longer flickers when scrolled to the bottom

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Claude provider bug that can happen in f5. Reimplement inside f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: When Claude accepts an Auto request as Manual, the adapter restores the mode reported by the first init frame, so follow-up turns stop retrying the rejected Auto mode.
topics.title: Claude follow-ups no longer fail in Auto on models that lack Auto

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for message delivery. The upstream code is in orchestration-v2, so reimplement it in f5's orchestration layer if f5 has the same gap.

topics.summary: While a run is active but its current attempt has no running provider turn, automatic messages are queued instead of being rejected as steers.
topics.title: Auto-delivered messages queue between provider turns

suggestion.reason: Fixes misleading effort labels on subagent bars in f5's timeline. Reimplement it outside client-runtime.

topics.summary: The subagent bar shows only a stored or reported effort for the same model and instance, instead of falling back to a catalog default such as Medium.
topics.title: Subagent bar stops guessing the subagent's effort

suggestion.reason: Visible readability fix in the timeline minimap.

topics.summary: Assistant replies are parsed with remark into plain text for the minimap tooltip. Parsing is capped at the first 1,500 characters.
topics.title: Minimap hover previews show plain text, not raw Markdown
fix(mobile): picking a model shows its remembered options before saving (#15719)

suggestion.reason: This reliability bug stops provider status and usage from refreshing until the window is reloaded.

topics.summary: Each environment's activity report uses ignoreCause instead of ignore, so an interrupt during session teardown no longer ends the reporting loop. Provider health and usage keep refreshing after sleep/wake.
topics.title: Client activity reporting survives an interrupted report
fix(mobile): expanded tool-call groups keep following new calls (#15747)

suggestion.reason: Fixes desktop network endpoint detection, which f5 shows under Connections.

topics.summary: Desktop endpoint discovery identifies Tailscale IPs from the parsed tailscale status and shares one cached status read. Proton VPN's CGNAT address is no longer labeled Tailscale or put in pairing links.
topics.title: Tailscale endpoints exclude other VPNs' 100.64/10 addresses

topics.reason: f5 has no scheduled tasks subsystem.

suggestion.reason: f5 has no scheduled tasks subsystem.

topics.summary: Interval schedules advance by elapsed duration instead of zoned wall-clock time.
topics.title: Scheduled-task intervals keep elapsed time across DST

suggestion.reason: Fixes a gap in the existing auto-settlement feature. It adds no new automatic behavior.

topics.summary: A thread with no messages or runs uses its creation time as its activity anchor, so automatic settlement applies to it after the inactivity window. Before, it stayed in the active list forever.
topics.title: Empty inactive threads settle automatically

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for a race in turn starts. It must be reimplemented in f5's layers.

topics.summary: After each await, the turn start service checks that this attempt is still current and still starting. Obsolete attempts stop before opening a session or ensuring, resuming or forking the native thread.
topics.title: Superseded provider startups stop before opening sessions

suggestion.reason: Fixes premature completion and duplicate alerts for Claude background wakes.

topics.summary: When Claude ends an empty turn and opens the next one within milliseconds, the empty turn's result no longer settles the run. The thread stays working and completes once.
topics.title: Claude wake runs no longer end empty while Claude is still answering

suggestion.reason: Timeline UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The assistant selection toolbar hides during scrolling and comes back about 150 ms after scrolling stops if the selected text is still visible. Before, scrolling dismissed it for good.
topics.title: Cite button returns after the timeline stops scrolling

suggestion.reason: Only matters when the local environment is disabled and remote environments are used.

topics.summary: Without a primary environment, global shortcut handlers read the first connected environment that has loaded config.
topics.title: Custom shortcuts work when the Local environment is off

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Windows worktree bug that blocks recreating a checkout.

topics.summary: After git worktree remove succeeds, leftover links are unlinked and the empty directories left behind are removed, so the checkout can be created again. Ordinary files are kept.
topics.title: Removing a worktree on Windows no longer leaves junctions behind

suggestion.reason: Fixes usage limits that stayed empty for Claude in f5's usage surface.

topics.summary: Only a fresh result that includes usage keeps the 5-minute TTL. An unauthenticated status clears the cache, so limits appear right after signing back in.
topics.title: Failed or signed-out Claude usage probes are no longer cached

suggestion.reason: Fixes terminal link detection in a file f5 has.

topics.summary: A route that has a query string and follows an HTTP method or 'proxying' (e.g. GET /api/x?batch=1) is no longer detected as a file link. Real paths and URLs still link.
topics.title: Logged request routes in the terminal are no longer file links

suggestion.reason: Fixes user-configured Codex MCP servers being dropped.

topics.summary: Thread config sets only the dotted mcp_servers.t3-code key instead of replacing the whole mcp_servers table, so MCP servers from launch arguments are kept.
topics.title: Codex MCP servers from launch arguments survive T3's server config

suggestion.reason: f5's PR hub supports GitLab. Rebuild this inside f5's GitLab forge layer.

topics.summary: When the first /diffs page returns not found, the GitLab CLI client falls back to /changes?access_raw_diffs=true and keeps the truncation signals. The Code tab then loads on older GitLab.
topics.title: Merge request diffs load on GitLab before 15.7
fix(mobile): app no longer stays on Loading environments after a locked background launch (#15894)
fix(mobile): account badges no longer clip wide initials like WO (#15908)

suggestion.reason: This fixes the legacy V1 importer in orchestration-v2. f5 does not have that subsystem or that import path.

topics.summary: The V1 to V2 thread importer drops unreadable optional message context but keeps the message. Background hydration marks a failed thread for retry and moves on to later threads.
topics.title: One bad legacy message no longer stops server startup

suggestion.reason: Upstream product analytics.

topics.summary: Adds the anonymous PostHog events feature.used and mcp.tool.invoked, with provider and delegation dimensions.
topics.title: Analytics count product feature and MCP tool usage

suggestion.reason: A command palette UX fix.

topics.summary: Nested palette views and file or content search keep the parent query, and Back or Escape restores it. Closing the palette or opening it fresh resets it.
topics.title: Going back in the command palette keeps the search that led there
fix(mobile): match subscription widgets to app theme (#15941)

suggestion.reason: Repairs upstream-specific release data and the V1-to-V2 import, neither of which f5 has.

topics.summary: Migration 066 repairs settlement timestamps from upstream desktop 0.0.35 to 0.0.38 sweeps, in the V1 and imported V2 projections.
topics.title: Migration repairs settled times stamped by old desktop sweeps

suggestion.reason: Fixes a user-visible bug in f5's keybinding settings for users on non-US keyboard layouts.

topics.summary: Recording a shortcut keeps the character the layout produces, such as # or ' on German, instead of the US physical punctuation key. US shifted glyphs still normalize to shift+key. Alt recording is unchanged.
topics.title: Keybinding editor records the typed character on non-US layouts

topics.reason: Applies only to the Clerk sign-in flow, which is covered by relay-cloud.

suggestion.reason: Applies only to the Clerk sign-in flow, which is covered by relay-cloud.

topics.summary: On unpackaged, non-development Windows runs, the Clerk OAuth callback is registered with the Electron executable and main.cjs.
topics.title: Windows OAuth callbacks register with the app entry point

suggestion.reason: Accessibility fix in the timeline and settings, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Scroll to end, composer paging, minimap navigation, Theme Editor reveal and send anchoring check prefers-reduced-motion and position immediately when it is set.
topics.title: Programmatic scrolls jump instead of glide when Reduce Motion is on
fix(mobile): scroll to end jumps instead of glides when Reduce Motion is on (#16015)

suggestion.reason: A small, low-risk UX polish in the thread view.

topics.summary: When only one subagent is pending, its link reads Show, with the accessible name Show subagent <name>. Multiple tasks keep their named links.
topics.title: Waiting banner stops repeating a single subagent's name

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale network endpoint data in desktop settings.

topics.summary: Atom.keepAlive moves before Atom.swr, so the SWR wrapper revalidates on remount. Connections then shows current endpoints after Tailscale connects or disconnects.
topics.title: Connections refreshes stale desktop endpoints when reopened

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance gain in diff views, which f5 uses.

topics.summary: The Pierre diffs patch renders only the header for a collapsed file and skips syntax highlighting until the file is expanded. Scrolling large diffs gets cheaper.
topics.title: Collapsed diff files wait to highlight until they are opened

suggestion.reason: It fixes a terminal opening in the wrong directory, in the terminal and worktrees surface.

topics.summary: A reopened terminal uses its own saved location, including worktreePath: null. Thread defaults apply only when the terminal has no location. Only the web part applies to f5.
topics.title: A checkout terminal stays off the thread's later worktree

suggestion.reason: The Device panel is an upstream devices and simulators feature.

topics.summary: Pending device actions and their errors are scoped to the thread that started them.
topics.title: Device panel results stay in the thread that started them

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: The mobile diagnostics screen reads the build number from expo-application.
topics.title: Mobile crash report shows the store build number

suggestion.reason: A small readability fix for provider instance badges, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Badge initials are black or white, whichever has better WCAG contrast against the accent color. Only the web part applies to f5.
topics.title: Provider badge initials stay readable on light accent colors

suggestion.reason: OpenCode threads currently get images only as attachment paths, so the model can miss them. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: Supported local images are sent as native prompt files, keeping the attachment-path text. A steer stopped during file lookup is rejected cleanly.
topics.title: OpenCode turns and steers send pasted images to the model

suggestion.reason: Shows the real reason for Cursor turn failures in the thread and to delegating agents.

topics.summary: Failure messages include the SDK's error message, code and status, such as Model Blocked or resource_exhausted, instead of 'Provider turn failed.' Delegating parents see the same reason.
topics.title: Failed Cursor turns show Cursor's reason

suggestion.reason: Timeline bug fix in files that exist in f5.

topics.summary: Minimap visibility is calculated from current geometry within the rendered buffer, so stale positions no longer highlight distant turns. Previous and next navigation use the same range.
topics.title: Timeline minimap highlights only the visible rows

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible rendering bug in timeline Mermaid diagrams, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The final DOMPurify pass now allows the KaTeX MathML elements and attributes that Mermaid emits, so $$...$$ labels are no longer blank. annotation, maction and mglyph stay stripped.
topics.title: Math labels in Mermaid diagrams render instead of empty boxes

suggestion.reason: Fixes a timeline copy bug that can happen in f5's chat markdown.

topics.summary: When a selection includes a rendered Mermaid diagram, the copied plaintext and HTML keep its fenced Mermaid source along with the selected prose. Selecting inside a diagram copies the whole source. Search-only source stays out of the clipboard.
topics.title: Copying selected text keeps the Mermaid diagram source

suggestion.reason: Clearer failure messages for providers f5 has. Reimplement in f5's provider layer, not upstream's provider-core.

topics.summary: Provider errors carry an optional reason. The failure banner shows fixed wording for an unreadable attachment or a still-active previous turn instead of a generic failure. Adapters mark these cases.
topics.title: Turn-start failures say why: unreadable attachment or previous turn still running

suggestion.reason: Fixes repository identity and PR features for partial clones.

topics.summary: git remote -v parsers accept a trailing [blob:none] filter annotation. Partial clones keep their repository identity, remote listings and forge resolution.
topics.title: Partial-clone remote annotations are parsed

suggestion.reason: Relay push service only.

topics.summary: The relay moves environmentId, threadId and deepLink under body, so Expo exposes them as notification data on iOS.
topics.title: iOS push notifications open their thread again

suggestion.reason: Fixes OpenCode models missing from the picker. This needs a reimplementation in f5's OpenCode provider layer.

topics.summary: Requires two matching non-empty catalog reads, within the existing 5-second limit, before caching. A cold OpenCode server can no longer leave a partial model list in the picker.
topics.title: OpenCode model catalog settles before it is cached

suggestion.reason: A git diff correctness fix that affects fork-based workflows in f5.

topics.summary: Branches with gh-merge-base set to a remote ref compare against that exact remote ref. Unrelated upstream commits no longer show up as feature changes.
topics.title: Changes honor a configured remote merge base such as upstream/main

suggestion.reason: Fixes storage cleanup coverage. Keep f5's storageCleanup.enabled default.

topics.summary: Cleanup reads active and archived threads in one snapshot, so archived checkouts follow the cleanup rules and count as worktree sharers in removal rechecks.
topics.title: Storage cleanup includes worktrees of archived threads

suggestion.reason: Fixes snoozed threads waking too early in f5. Reimplement it in f5's projection and client state, not in orchestration-v2 or client-runtime.

topics.summary: PR sync, PR-link updates and active reordering keep the thread's activity timestamp. A failure wakes the thread only based on the failed run's completion time, not on later runtime metadata.
topics.title: Snoozed threads no longer wake early after background updates

suggestion.reason: A small settings UX fix.

topics.summary: In Settings → Providers, the model name gets the available width first and the slug truncates. A focusable tooltip shows the full name and slug.
topics.title: Provider model names are no longer cut off by long slugs

suggestion.reason: Fixes a false Unavailable status for the OpenCode provider.

topics.summary: The OpenCode --version probe timeout goes from 4s to 10s, so wrapped installs that start slowly cold are detected.
topics.title: Slow OpenCode wrappers no longer show as unavailable

suggestion.reason: Fixes a startup race that drops provider instance settings.

topics.summary: The registry subscribes to settings changes before the seed read, and queued notifications reread the current settings. A failed read keeps the registry intact and is retried on the next change.
topics.title: Provider settings saved during startup are no longer lost

suggestion.reason: Fixes settings that carried over to the wrong model.

topics.summary: Project and checkout model selections now replace the saved options instead of merging with them, for the default, text-generation, writer and review-guide models.
topics.title: Changing a project's model drops the old model's options

suggestion.reason: Fixes dropped fast and priority options for delegated children.

topics.summary: delegate_task merges option overrides by id with the inherited options when provider and model are inherited. Task responses take provider, model and options from one child-run selection.
topics.title: Subagents keep fast mode when their reasoning effort is overridden

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong completion state in the Claude provider.

topics.summary: Goal completion also checks live subagent work by task type. Agent and workflow tasks defer completion, and an unknown task type defers it too, so clearing the goal can't discard work still running.
topics.title: Claude /goal no longer reads as complete while a background subagent runs

suggestion.reason: Fixes an unwanted background watch on forked threads in f5's PR hub and fork flow.

topics.summary: Forking a thread keeps its PR links but removes each link's watch, so the fork does not silently start watching the parent's pull requests.
topics.title: Forked threads no longer inherit pull request watches

suggestion.reason: An observability improvement in serverLogger, which exists in f5.

topics.summary: The console-pretty logger renders any Cause passed as a log field with Cause.pretty, so log lines show why a failure happened.
topics.title: Server logs print the full cause instead of [Object]

suggestion.reason: Fixes session import of Codex threads, a feature f5 has.

topics.summary: The import scanner ignores Codex session_meta records whose source is a subagent. Child rollouts no longer appear as separate threads or use up the recent-thread budget.
topics.title: Session import skips Codex subagent rollouts

suggestion.reason: Fixes Forgejo PR watches that never finish.

topics.summary: Forgejo check states map skipped to skipped and warning to neutral. Unknown states stay pending.
topics.title: Forgejo skipped jobs no longer keep a PR watch pending

suggestion.reason: Desktop deep-link fix for Linux AppImage users, if f5 registers a URL handler.

topics.summary: Older xdg-open fails to look up a quoted Exec path, so callbacks opened in a browser. The desktop entry now quotes the path only when it contains reserved characters.
topics.title: Linux URL handler quotes the Exec path only when it must

suggestion.reason: Users with bare-repo layouts can import their projects during onboarding.

topics.summary: The session scanner resolves a linked worktree's commondir and offers it when the shared config sets core.bare. Ordinary linked worktrees are still skipped.
topics.title: Onboarding offers worktrees of a bare repository

suggestion.reason: Responsiveness fix in the server preview browser.

topics.summary: Viewer navigation and history no longer block the input queue. Outstanding navigations are tracked and drained before an agent handoff.
topics.title: Browser input stays responsive during slow navigation

suggestion.reason: Measurable storage/perf improvement. It needs reimplementing in f5's OpenCode adapter if that adapter also shares sessions across threads.

topics.summary: setSessionStatus returns early when status and lastError are unchanged. Before, each repeat wrote one event per attached thread, which made up about 91% of session events on busy instances.
topics.title: OpenCode stops persisting unchanged session status updates

suggestion.reason: Provider bug fix that causes T3 tools to be lost. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: Each turn re-adds the T3 MCP server, because OpenCode drops runtime MCP servers when it evicts an idle Location. The orchestration instructions follow that turn's add result.
topics.title: OpenCode threads keep T3 tools after an idle project is evicted

suggestion.question: Does f5 have the server-side html_preview headless Chrome renderer?
suggestion.reason: Makes html_preview failures easier to diagnose, but only if the fork has the html render tool. Its paths are missing in the fork.

topics.summary: HtmlRenderBrowserError now includes the exit code or signal when headless Chrome exits before rendering.
topics.title: HTML preview errors report the headless browser's exit code or signal

suggestion.reason: Visual fix in a git dialog f5 has.

topics.summary: Dialog visibility is separate from the pending action, so the title and labels don't change during the exit animation. Permission checks are kept.
topics.title: Default-branch confirmation keeps its text while closing

suggestion.reason: Prevents lost messages during Stop. Needs reimplementing in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: Steer, restart and queued-message promotion are rejected when the persisted Stop marker shows the run is stopping. A plain send queues instead, so the message is not lost.
topics.title: A message promoted into a stopping run stays queued

suggestion.reason: Fixes a small usage UI bug. Port the web part only.

topics.summary: Web limit bars look up the driver in PROVIDER_PRESENTATION, so Cursor, Grok and OpenCode bars no longer fall back to the foreground color. The mobile changes don't apply to f5.
topics.title: Usage limit bars use each provider's chart color

suggestion.reason: Stops stale clicks or navigation after the caller has timed out in the preview browser.

topics.summary: Queued browser actions check one request deadline right before they start. Stopping a recording still runs after the deadline, and the initial navigation stays tracked for human handoff.
topics.title: Queued preview actions don't start after their caller timed out

suggestion.reason: User-visible bug fix in Open in and file preview.

topics.summary: OpenInPicker takes a revealFileManager prop. The file preview sets it, so choosing the file manager sends reveal: true instead of opening the file in its default app.
topics.title: Open in → Finder from the file preview reveals the file

suggestion.reason: Devices and simulators only.

topics.summary: Pointer presses with a button other than the primary one are no longer forwarded to the device as touches.
topics.title: Flat Device viewport ignores right and middle clicks

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance gain for f5's orchestrator MCP tools on long threads.

topics.summary: An empty turn-item filter list now skips the SQLite query that would match no rows. This saves 15 to 280 ms per MCP projection read on long threads.
topics.title: MCP thread reads skip the turn-item scan when the filter is empty

suggestion.reason: A one-line fix that makes the usage notice actionable.

topics.summary: When Codex needs sign-in, the unavailable usage result carries the account status message instead of 'Could not read limits'. Rate-limit failures still take precedence.
topics.title: Codex usage notice keeps the codex login guidance

suggestion.reason: Usage display fix for a provider f5 has. Reimplement outside packages/provider-grok.

topics.summary: When a complete, valid weekly or monthly period is missing creditUsagePercent, it is reported as 0% instead of being dropped. Invalid periods are still omitted.
topics.title: Grok billing periods with zero use are shown

suggestion.reason: Fixes clipped rows in the command palette, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The command palette's list panel becomes a flex column with min-h-0, and the Repository header no longer shrinks. The last environment or option row can be reached again.
topics.title: New Project options scroll above the footer

suggestion.reason: Fixes the timeline jumping back to the bottom while the user scrolls.

topics.summary: Scrolling up on the timeline container turns off live follow even when the input came from inside a sandboxed frame. Programmatic positioning is ignored.
topics.title: Scrolling over an inline HTML render no longer snaps to the bottom

suggestion.reason: Fixes a checkpoint bug that breaks the user's checkout. f5 has checkpoints.

topics.summary: Checkpoint capture writes its scratch index with core.splitIndex=false and sharedIndexExpire=never. Before, it could expire the sharedindex file and break every git command in repos using splitIndex.
topics.title: Checkpoints no longer delete a shared split index the repo still uses

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong model labels on subagent cards for f5's Claude provider.

topics.summary: The model snapshot ignores '<synthetic>', the model name Claude puts on its own usage-limit and API-error notices. Subagent cards keep showing the real model.
topics.title: Claude subagents keep their model after a usage-limit notice

suggestion.reason: Fixes a composer menu that would not open.

topics.summary: The chevron now cancels the default focus on mousedown instead of on pointerdown, so Base UI can open the menu.
topics.title: Implementation actions menu opens and keeps composer focus

suggestion.reason: Fixes snoozed threads waking early, in f5's snooze feature. It must be reimplemented in f5's layers.

topics.summary: A successful run requested before, at the time of, or without a known time relative to the snooze no longer wakes the thread. Work requested later still wakes it. The client, server settlement and MCP guidance share this rule.
topics.title: Snooze survives completion of a run requested before snoozing

suggestion.reason: UX fix in the Files panel.

topics.summary: When a tree search has no matches, the Files panel shows an empty-result message instead of Pierre's fallback to the full unfiltered tree.
topics.title: Files panel shows 'No matching files.' for an empty search

suggestion.reason: Checkpoint diff bug that f5 can hit. Reimplement in f5's checkpoint query.

topics.summary: Adjacent-turn diffs use the ready checkpoint at the previous ordinal in the same scope, even when it came from a stopped run or has no run. This fixes 'Failed to load turn diff'.
topics.title: The turn after a stopped turn shows its diff again

suggestion.reason: A small UX fix for the new-thread headline, if the fork has the draft hero.

topics.summary: Replaces the fixed max-w-64 on the project selector with a width based on the available space. The project name and '?' are kept together on one line.
topics.title: Draft headline truncates the project name only when it has to

suggestion.reason: Turns a generic preview capture toast into an actionable message.

topics.summary: A tagged capture failure carries its reason and stage across desktop IPC. Recording keeps the original NotReadableError and its recovery guidance even when cleanup also fails.
topics.title: Preview capture failures keep their actionable native error

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stuck running compaction item in Codex threads.

topics.summary: Pending compaction ids are tracked for each active Codex turn and settled by the turn finalizer, so compactions no longer stay running after a failure or Stop. Failed and stopped labels take precedence over token summaries.
topics.title: Codex compaction items settle when the turn ends

suggestion.reason: Fixes sidebar project grouping, a bug that can happen in f5.

topics.summary: When the work-tree root query fails, repository identity detects a bare repository, reads its remotes with an explicit git dir and uses that dir as the root path. Bare-repo projects then group with checkouts of the same remote.
topics.title: Bare repositories group with projects that share their remote

suggestion.reason: The same flicker can happen in f5's thread shell state. Reimplement the fix outside client-runtime.

topics.summary: The shell reducer keeps a thread's existing PR links when a reconnect snapshot changes other metadata. Before, PR badges disappeared until the deferred link data loaded.
topics.title: PR links stay visible on reconnect when thread metadata changes

suggestion.reason: Fixes Cursor effort display in a provider f5 supports.

topics.summary: Adds Cursor's reasoning_effort to the shared effort option lookup. Subagent tooltips then show the effort, and the traits picker groups Fast and steps effort correctly.
topics.title: Subagent cards and traits picker recognize Cursor reasoning effort

suggestion.reason: Gives agents an accurate error from the preview browser tools, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The close tool returns the broker's typed error, such as agentMismatch, instead of a generic orchestration_error.
topics.title: t3_preview_close reports the server browser's refusal

suggestion.reason: Changes only the Tiptap rich-text composer, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: A plugin tracks typed backtick pairs. Moving the caret past the closing tick applies the code mark instead of leaving literal backticks.
topics.title: Text typed between backticks becomes inline code in the rich composer

suggestion.question: Does f5 ship the SnapShot window-capture feature and its GNOME extension?
suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop compatibility issue, but only if the fork ships the SnapShot GNOME extension. Its paths are missing in the fork.

topics.summary: Adds '51' to the extension's shell-version list and bumps its version, so it loads on GNOME 51.
topics.title: SnapShot GNOME extension supports GNOME Shell 51

suggestion.question: Does f5 keep the Device panel and SSH device hosts, so device-host fixes should be ported?
suggestion.reason: SshDeviceHost belongs to the device subsystem, which f5 lacks.

topics.summary: The tunnel spawn disables ControlMaster, ControlPath and ControlPersist, so it stops reconnect-looping and leaking listeners until ephemeral ports run out.
topics.title: SSH device-host tunnels no longer inherit ControlMaster

suggestion.reason: Device hub SSH hosts are part of the devices and simulators subsystem.

topics.summary: The tunnel runs a remote stdin reader with piped stdin. When the server exits, the reader gets EOF and SSH exits instead of being left orphaned.
topics.title: Device-host SSH tunnels exit when the server dies

suggestion.reason: Fix to the scheduled-tasks subsystem, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Worktree requests for Scratch projects are normalized to root, so scheduled tasks without a project no longer fail on Git operations.
topics.title: Scheduled tasks for No project launch in a scratch folder

suggestion.reason: Fixes MCP orchestration tools that disagree with the PR link data.

topics.summary: t3_thread_list and t3_thread_read add a pullRequests array of visible links with host, repo, number, url, source and state, matching list_thread_pull_requests. Orchestrators no longer see null for linked threads.
topics.title: MCP thread list and read report every linked pull request

suggestion.reason: UX fix to the composer usage-limit notice, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Resume at reset and Snooze until reset failures are reported with an error toast, so the composer notice keeps its one-row layout and stays readable.
topics.title: Usage-limit recovery errors show as toasts instead of crushing the banner

topics.reason: f5 does not have the scheduled tasks subsystem.

suggestion.reason: f5 does not have the scheduled tasks subsystem.

topics.summary: The MCP tool returns the thread the run actually dispatched to, instead of the task's binding.
topics.title: run_scheduled_task_now returns the thread it launched

suggestion.reason: Handoff budget belongs to upstream's context-handoff subsystem in packages/provider-cursor.

topics.summary: Cursor handoffs use the selected or catalog-default context window instead of a 128K fallback.
topics.title: Cursor handoff budgets use the selected context window

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Codex bug that can happen in f5: the Limited state and resume controls were hidden. The logic has to be reimplemented in f5's Codex adapter.

topics.summary: When Codex runs out of retries and the last attempt's status was 429, the turn is classified as usage_limit instead of a generic provider error. An explicit completion status wins over contradictory cached notification evidence.
topics.title: Codex retries that run out on HTTP 429 show as usage limits

suggestion.reason: This fixes a reliability bug in the preview browser on desktop: agent browser calls on a long-open tab can fail.

topics.summary: The desktop preview manager now listens for the debugger detach event. It releases the stale control session and detaches the server tab, so the next agent browser call reattaches instead of failing until the page is reloaded.
topics.title: Preview tab reattaches after Chromium drops its debugger

suggestion.reason: Fixes a notification bug f5 users can hit.

topics.summary: playNotificationSound skips a sound while the same sound is still playing, so bursts no longer stack into loud, distorted audio.
topics.title: Threads finishing together play one completion sound

suggestion.reason: f5 has thread snooze. The symptom can occur there. Reimplement in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: The settlement event now clears snoozedUntil and snoozedAt, so server confirmation no longer puts the thread back into Snoozed after the user settles it.
topics.title: Settling a snoozed thread clears its snooze on the server too

suggestion.reason: Fixes invisible caret in inline diff/file comments if f5 has editable file previews with comments.

topics.summary: Inline comment annotations restore visible caret and selection overridden by Pierre's editable surface.
topics.title: Show native caret and selection in file comments

suggestion.reason: Device hub and agent device tool settings are a devices-only subsystem.

topics.summary: The Integrations update popover shows the server error message. Failed npm installs report their exit code instead of a generic network hint.
topics.title: Device tool update failures show the server error instead of network advice

suggestion.reason: Server-browser pages render without text on minimal Linux hosts. This fixes that preview browser bug.

topics.summary: Setup checks for a usable font with fc-match. Without root, it reports the missing fonts and no longer says the host is ready. As root with apt, it installs fontconfig and fonts-liberation.
topics.title: t3 browser setup detects and installs missing fonts
fix(mobile): Chinese input no longer breaks before a skill pill on iOS (#17614)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading action in provider settings. The affected files exist in the fork.

topics.summary: The update command is hidden when the installed version is already the package's latest, as with OpenCode 1.x when 2.x is recommended.
topics.title: Settings stops offering a provider update that cannot clear a limited-support warning
fix(mobile): prevent environment row taps from swallowing switches (#17677)

suggestion.reason: A user-visible preview browser capability. The default is unchanged.

topics.summary: Settings → Integrations → Browser gets a Search engine picker with presets and a custom %s template. Invalid templates fall back to DuckDuckGo, which stays the default.
topics.title: Choose the in-app browser's search engine

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in the file preview panel, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The workspace HTML/PDF preview document stays mounted until its environment, kind, thread, file or workspace revision changes. Before, a signed asset URL renewal reloaded it and threw away unsaved form input and scroll.
topics.title: HTML file previews keep form input when their signed URL renews

suggestion.reason: T3 Connect and relay only.

topics.summary: The CLI warns to deregister from the T3 Connect page when unlink or logout cannot revoke the relay record.
topics.title: t3 connect unlink warns when the relay record is left behind

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing usage for OpenCode instances. It is the sibling of the Antigravity change.

topics.summary: OpenCode usage roots are resolved from each instance's environment and deduplicated, so histories of other instances are counted.
topics.title: OpenCode usage reads each instance's data directory

suggestion.reason: Usage bug fix for Antigravity instances.

topics.summary: Usage roots are resolved from each instance's ANTIGRAVITY_DATA_DIR, with the default-instance fallback kept, so histories of other instances are counted.
topics.title: Antigravity usage reads each instance's data directory

suggestion.reason: f5 has queued messages and usage-limit resume; if its orchestration orders the transcript similarly, the symptom can occur. Reimplement in f5's layer.

topics.summary: Queued runs started after a resume get a newer run ordinal so the transcript order matches execution order.
topics.title: Queued messages render after a resume turn that ran before them

suggestion.reason: It fixes thread snooze and settle behavior that f5 has.

topics.summary: Auto-settlement now uses the shared isSnoozed predicate, so interrupted or cancelled runs keep the snooze protection the sidebar shows.
topics.title: An interrupted run no longer starts the settle timer on a snoozed thread

suggestion.reason: Clearer git error messages in f5.

topics.summary: Worktree creation and branch switching classify missing-ref stderr as ref_not_found and add a fixed message suffix.
topics.title: Git failures caused by a missing ref say so

suggestion.reason: A UX fix in the composer approval panel, a file that exists in f5.

topics.summary: Command, file and permission approval details use pre-wrap with overflow-wrap anywhere and a 160px scroll area, so long commands no longer require scrolling sideways.
topics.title: Long approval commands wrap inside the composer

suggestion.reason: This only targets the Tiptap composer, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Removes the top and bottom margins of the first and last blocks in .composer-tiptap, so a leading list or quote is not clipped in the one-line composer.
topics.title: Collapsed composer centers drafts that start with a list

suggestion.reason: Fixes images going missing during composer copy and paste, which f5 users can hit.

topics.summary: The files behind the latest composer copy are kept for the browser tab and imported through the normal attachment path. Pastes no longer lose images whose upload was still running or whose source attachment was removed.
topics.title: Images copied from unsent drafts survive paste
fix(mobile): iOS composer text stays vertically aligned at every text size (#17855)

suggestion.reason: Small accessibility fix in the new-thread hero, if f5 has the same headline.

topics.summary: Removes the explicit aria-label from the new-thread heading, which hid the inline project picker from NVDA in browse mode.
topics.title: NVDA browse mode can reach the new-thread project picker again

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible flicker in f5's diff panel.

topics.summary: The diff panel shows a skeleton only while the selected query has no result, so a loaded empty diff keeps its empty state during background refresh.
topics.title: Empty diff panel no longer flashes a loading skeleton on refresh

topics.reason: Only the mobile app changes behavior. The shared change only adds a URL constant.

suggestion.reason: Only the mobile app changes behavior. The shared change only adds a URL constant.

topics.summary: Mobile environment update checks use GitHub's public latest-release JSON and Atom feed, with the paginated API kept as a fallback.
topics.title: Mobile server update checks avoid GitHub API rate limit

suggestion.reason: Prevents worktree cleanup from misjudging the default branch and removing unmerged work.

topics.summary: When there is no local remote HEAD ref, cleanup asks the remote for its advertised HEAD and caches the result. If no default can be found, the worktree is kept rather than guessing main.
topics.title: Storage cleanup asks the remote for its default branch when HEAD ref is missing

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading storage-cleanup estimate in a subsystem f5 has. f5's storageCleanup.enabled default stays as it is.

topics.summary: Worktree size measurement skips files with more than one hardlink and counts allocated blocks for the rest. Removing a worktree whose dependencies are hardlinked from a shared store no longer reports space that was not actually freed.
topics.title: Storage cleanup no longer counts hardlinked files as recovered space

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for the OpenCode provider. Reimplement outside packages/provider-*.

topics.summary: Classifies a SQLITE_BUSY startup exit as databaseLocked and retries up to three times, 250 ms apart, instead of failing the new thread.
topics.title: OpenCode startup retries when the shared database is locked

suggestion.reason: Small UX fix to a composer notice f5 has.

topics.summary: The update status title and stage/error message go into the standard notice slots, so details appear only when the text is clipped, and a long failure no longer pushes the dismiss button onto a new row.
topics.title: Server update banner offers details only when its text is clipped

suggestion.reason: Small preview browser bug fix in shared code that f5 has.

topics.summary: URL normalization uses an anchored scheme check, so localhost:3000/?next=https://… opens the local app instead of starting a search.
topics.title: Preview addresses that contain another URL open instead of searching

suggestion.reason: A safety fix. Before it, writes ran silently in Plan mode.

topics.summary: Plan mode always installs the permission callback, so writes need client approval in any runtime mode. When the approval policy is never, the callback denies right away.
topics.title: Claude Plan mode asks before writes in Auto and Full access
fix(mobile): lift thread status above composer suggestions (#17964)

suggestion.reason: A terminal input bug. Port it if f5's terminal maps keys only by physical code; the Ghostty files are not in the fork.

topics.summary: When the physical key code is empty or not mapped, the Ghostty key mapping falls back to the logical key, so Backspace works on Android browsers.
topics.title: Terminal handles Backspace when Android leaves out the key code

suggestion.reason: A UX fix on f5's Usage page.

topics.summary: Limit bars and legend buttons share one popover, which moves between segments instead of opening a second one. It closes when its account or window disappears.
topics.title: Usage limits show one account popover at a time

suggestion.reason: This only affects pairing links for other devices, which falls under pairing and remote access that f5 does not ship.

topics.summary: The desktop advertises an address on a normal interface before bridges, VPN tunnels and VM adapters when it builds local network pairing links.
topics.title: Local network pairing links prefer real LAN interfaces over bridges and tunnels

suggestion.reason: Bug fix in the PR hub.

topics.summary: The PR title editor ignores key events with isComposing set or keyCode 229, so confirming IME input no longer saves a half-typed title.
topics.title: PR title editor ignores Enter during IME composition

suggestion.reason: Fixes failed authentication when opening remote files in an editor, which f5's Open in picker also does.

topics.summary: VS Code-compatible, Zed and JetBrains remote links now include the environment's SSH user for configured, Tailscale and mDNS targets. Before, the local editor could try the viewer's own account and fail to authenticate.
topics.title: Remote editor links keep the SSH login user

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop update UX bug that can happen in f5.

topics.summary: When an update check finds the release already cached, the app runs the download path again. electron-updater validates the cache and restores the restart prompt without downloading again.
topics.title: Restart prompt returns after relaunching with a downloaded update

suggestion.reason: Timeline status bug in subagent rows. f5 has Claude subagents.

topics.summary: When a failed Claude background subagent is resumed, its parent notification row shows the live status instead of keeping a red Failed badge.
topics.title: Resumed subagent notification row shows running instead of failed

suggestion.reason: Gives agents in f5's orchestration MCP accurate delegation diagnostics.

topics.summary: For disabled instances, MCP capabilities and delegation report only the disabled reason, not placeholder install, health or auth failures.
topics.title: Disabled providers no longer report missing executables in MCP capabilities

suggestion.reason: Provider settings UX fix that applies to f5's update notices.

topics.summary: Manual-only installs (mise, node_modules, unofficial Muse binaries) get their own wording that names the install, instead of promising a Settings update action that does not exist.
topics.title: Provider update notices explain how to update installs T3 cannot update

suggestion.reason: Fixes missed PR watch updates for Forgejo forges.

topics.summary: The Forgejo comment decoder keeps updated_at and exposes editedAt, so the watch evaluator notices when a bot edits an existing comment.
topics.title: Forgejo PR watches wake for edited comments

suggestion.reason: Keyboard bug in the right panel tabs, which f5 has (the path exists).

topics.summary: The shortcut blocker now matches only open or closing popups, so closed keepMounted popovers no longer swallow launcher letters and Mod+T.
topics.title: Right-panel launcher letters work while a closed menu stays mounted

suggestion.reason: Crash fix in the PR and diff file tree.

topics.summary: Colliding files get an internal alias in the Pierre diff file tree. Selection and reveal map back to the real paths, and the original icons are kept.
topics.title: Diffs with a file and folder at the same path no longer crash the tree

suggestion.reason: Corrects subagent and workflow timing for Claude. Needs reimplementing in f5's adapter layer.

topics.summary: The terminal lastProgressAt is used as the completion instant for a workflow member, instead of startedAt plus durationMs, which leaves out startup waits. Retries clear it.
topics.title: Claude workflow members keep their real completion time

topics.reason: Scheduled tasks are an upstream-only subsystem.

suggestion.reason: Scheduled tasks are an upstream-only subsystem.

topics.summary: The thread automations panel adds a wrapped tooltip for truncated titles and schedules.
topics.title: Hovering a thread automation shows its full title and schedule

suggestion.reason: Fixes cross-thread interference in the preview browser. The files exist in f5.

topics.summary: The preview broker's assignment key now includes the thread id, so threads sharing a Codex/OpenCode session no longer share a current tab, tab budget or ownership.
topics.title: Preview browser tabs are isolated per thread when threads share a provider session

suggestion.reason: Preview browser bug fix.

topics.summary: The idle sweep only closes headless agent tabs, so a desktop tab the user is reading is no longer closed.
topics.title: Desktop-rendered preview tabs are kept out of idle cleanup

suggestion.reason: ThreadRelationshipsControl lineage UI and client-runtime are upstream-only.

topics.summary: The lineage row for a provider-native workflow coordinator now uses its root-turn status instead of showing Idle.
topics.title: Member lineage shows native coordinator status

suggestion.reason: Fixes a checkpoint and branch-listing bug that can happen in f5's git layer.

topics.summary: A relative git common dir is resolved against the real (physical) cwd. Before, checkpoints could fail or write their scratch index into another repo, and ref discovery could list the wrong repo's branches.
topics.title: Projects opened through a symlinked subfolder resolve the right git common dir

suggestion.reason: This is client-runtime environment supervision for multi-environment and T3 Connect handoffs. Neither exists in f5.

suggestion.reason: Only affects devices and simulators.

suggestion.reason: Both the fix and the ownership race that causes the bug live in upstream orchestration-v2's Orchestrator, which f5 doesn't have.

topics.title: Stop no longer leaves a killed background command showing as running

suggestion.reason: Observability improvement for the usage hub source f5 has.

topics.title: Limits hub failures name the TLS, HTTP or timeout cause

suggestion.reason: A UX safety fix in the PR hub, which f5 has.

topics.title: Close with comment asks for confirmation before closing a PR

suggestion.reason: A small MCP capability gain for agent orchestration.

topics.title: t3_thread_read reports which thread sent a message
fix(mobile): usage chart legend wraps instead of pushing the end date off-screen (#18203)

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong thread settlement, which can happen in f5's settlement logic. Reimplement inside f5's layers.

topics.title: Threads don't settle after merging PRs that were already merged when linked

suggestion.reason: Approval UX improvement for the Codex provider. Reimplement in f5's Codex adapter.

topics.summary: Keeps the paths and change kinds from item/started for each item in the active turn, so modern file-change approvals show filenames instead of a generic prompt.
topics.title: Codex file-change approvals list the files they change

suggestion.reason: This is a small settings UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The agent browser access row moves into the existing Browser section of Integrations settings. The duplicate integrations category is removed from project defaults.
topics.title: Integrations settings show one Browser section

suggestion.reason: Windows clone bug that f5 can hit. Reimplement in f5's clone service.

topics.summary: Clone destination setup creates the parent directory only when it is missing. This avoids EPERM from a recursive mkdir on a Windows drive root.
topics.title: Cloning into a new folder directly under a drive root works

suggestion.reason: f5 ships Muse and has usage-limit handling. This turns a false failure into the correct Limited state.

topics.summary: The Muse adapter tracks usage/changed reports and classifies a 429 'subscription quota exhausted' failure as usage_limit with a reset time. Resume at reset, snooze and auto-resume then apply.
topics.title: Muse turns stopped by the subscription quota show Limited, not failed

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug where a settings choice was ignored in git actions and the inspector.

topics.summary: The Changes row and the file_change inspector now use the diff-addition and diff-deletion color tokens, so they follow the Blue & orange setting.
topics.title: Diff counts follow the selected diff color palette

suggestion.reason: Improves PR descriptions in f5's git and PR flow. Reimplement without upstream's provider-core handoff budget modules.

topics.summary: The PR writer gets a bounded digest of the thread's visible history, including command exit codes and output tails, so descriptions report tests that ran. Thread-aware PR creation requires thread-read permission.
topics.title: Generated PR descriptions include the thread's test and command history

suggestion.reason: Only affects upstream's devices and simulators tooling.

topics.summary: The agent-device shim wrappers and launcher set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, so the device CLI starts as Node.
topics.title: agent-device no longer launches the desktop app from Codex shells

suggestion.reason: Visible timeline improvement in chat markdown.

topics.summary: A closed Mermaid fence renders right away instead of staying as source until the whole response ends. Unfinished fences stay as source.
topics.title: Completed Mermaid blocks render while the response is still streaming

suggestion.reason: Fixes skills disappearing from the composer for f5's providers.

topics.summary: The registry keeps successful skill scans even when a provider's health status is error, so Codex, OpenCode and Pi skills stay in the $ and / menus.
topics.title: Workspace skills stay in the composer when provider health checks fail

suggestion.reason: Only matters when drafts move between environments.

topics.summary: Thread chips from another environment are marked invalid, and Send is blocked. Auto picks only environments that own all referenced threads.
topics.title: Composer blocks sending threads attached from another environment

suggestion.reason: Fixes review-guide content in the PR hub.

topics.summary: Finds the base remote by the verified repository's effective fetch URL instead of the primary remote. A stale fork origin no longer pulls unrelated commits into the guide.
topics.title: Review guides in a fork checkout cover only the pull request's change

suggestion.reason: Tiny sidebar visual fix; apply if f5's sidebar has the same padded empty thread list.

topics.summary: Thread list gets empty:hidden so collapsed projects don't show a 4px border line.
topics.title: Collapsed projects no longer leave a border stub

suggestion.reason: OpenCode provider fix. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter, since packages/provider-opencode does not exist here.

topics.summary: The OpenCode 2 adapter maps provider.quota and provider.rate-limit errors to the usage_limit class instead of a generic provider error.
topics.title: OpenCode Go quota and rate-limit stops show as usage limits
fix(mobile): don't send or paste attached threads a machine can't read (#18322)
feat(mobile): put Duo thread filtering beside compose in the rail (#18324)

suggestion.reason: Linux reliability fix for the Codex provider, if f5 launches it in systemd scopes.

topics.summary: The Codex app-server's systemd scope uses OOMPolicy=continue when it is supported. An OOM kill of one tool then no longer interrupts other Codex threads on the same instance.
topics.title: A tool killed for running out of memory no longer stops the shared Codex app-server

suggestion.reason: A user-visible fix for the Claude context meter. Reimplement it in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: Claude usage reports include the configured auto-compact window when it is below the model's context window. The meter then says compaction happens at about that value.
topics.title: Claude context meter shows the configured auto-compact threshold

suggestion.reason: Terminal bug fix whose symptom can occur in f5.

topics.summary: Reusing a terminal for a project script now picks only idle drawer terminals. Before, actions could run in the panel's PTY, which then showed in both places, and closing the drawer copy killed the panel shell.
topics.title: Project actions no longer run in the right-panel terminal

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for orchestration MCP retries.

topics.summary: An already-accepted create_threads request replays after its project disables the provider, using the recorded child instance and model. Fresh creations and prompts that were never accepted stay blocked.
topics.title: Retried MCP thread creation replays after the provider is disabled

suggestion.reason: Fixes a broken subagent thread link. It must be reimplemented in f5's Claude adapter layers.

topics.summary: Recovered Claude subagent tasks emit a create-only app_thread.created event. The ingestor creates the child thread once and keeps an existing title and model, so the subagent no longer shows Thread unavailable.
topics.title: Recovered Claude subagents get their child thread

suggestion.reason: Desktop reliability fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Main and splash window setup stop when shutdown begins. PreviewManager refuses to adopt a window destroyed during cleanup, so quitting mid-setup no longer acts on destroyed windows.
topics.title: Desktop stops window setup once the app starts quitting
fix(mobile): branch naming text saves when you leave the screen (#18381)
fix(mobile): preserve server matches in file search (#18388)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a chat file-link bug in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: For a basename-only chip, Open in editor and the copy actions resolve the path through the workspace index, as the preview already does, and keep line and column. Before, they pointed at a nonexistent file at the workspace root.
topics.title: Open in editor on a chat file chip opens the file the chip names

suggestion.reason: Composer UX fix for the Claude provider. Reimplement in f5's layers.

topics.summary: Unfinished Claude task lists for the same session stay visible between turns. They hide after completion or after a provider or session switch, and bounded snapshots keep the newest list.
topics.title: Claude task lists stay in the composer between turns

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost draft text in the composer.

topics.summary: When an image finishes compressing after the user switched threads, its reference chip is added to the original draft through the draft store. The other thread's text no longer overwrites that draft.
topics.title: Compressed image chips stay in their original draft

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for oversized diffs in the checkpoint diff query, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Filtered turn and thread diffs share one ordered byte budget across all git batches. The output is trimmed at a UTF-8 boundary and gets a truncation marker, so the combined diff no longer goes past 10 MB.
topics.title: Checkpoint diffs are capped at 10 MB across all batches

suggestion.reason: Affects only the developer dev-runner script. App users see no change.

topics.summary: The dev-electron pkill pattern escapes the worktree path and matches only the whole argument.
topics.title: Desktop dev cleanup no longer kills apps from other worktrees

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Claude provider bug whose symptom can occur in f5. It needs reimplementing in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: After a restart, the first task mutation loads Claude's saved task files from the instance config directory. A new TaskCreate no longer replaces the shown list with a single task.
topics.title: Claude task lists survive a server restart

suggestion.reason: A small UX improvement on f5's desktop update surfaces.

topics.summary: The desktop update state carries the disabled reason. The sidebar update pill's tooltip and accessible label, and Settings → About, show it.
topics.title: Disabled desktop update controls explain why

suggestion.reason: Fixes a reliability race in settings and keybindings delivery that can happen in f5.

topics.summary: The server-config stream subscribes to settings and keybinding changes before it reads the initial snapshot, so changes made while the snapshot loads are buffered instead of lost.
topics.title: Settings and keybinding changes are kept while the config snapshot loads

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in git and worktrees that f5 has.

topics.summary: findLocalHeadBranch searches refs by name and follows nextCursor instead of reading only the first 100 refs. Opening a PR whose worktree already exists no longer fails with a git fetch refusal.
topics.title: Opening a PR finds its existing worktree in repos with many branches

suggestion.reason: Fixes data loss in the settings f5 has.

topics.summary: When the keybinding is omitted and the action still exists, project script settings no longer delete its shortcut.
topics.title: Editing an action's name or command keeps its shortcut

suggestion.reason: The symptom needs the Local environment toggle and a backend pool, which come from upstream's multi-environment desktop. The f5 desktop update paths differ.

topics.summary: Before installing an update, the app records which backends were running. If the install fails, it restarts only those, so a disabled Local environment backend stays stopped.
topics.title: Failed desktop update no longer starts a disabled local backend

suggestion.reason: Codex agents in f5 likely miss part of their instructions because of the same cap. Reimplement the split in f5's Codex instruction builder.

topics.summary: Codex silently cuts the middle out of any additionalContext value over 1,000 tokens. The orchestration instructions are now split into numbered sections, each under 4,000 bytes, so Codex gets the whole guidance.
topics.title: Codex threads receive the full orchestration instructions

suggestion.reason: This fixes a timeline bug with imported threads.

topics.summary: Citation targeting finds the synthetic fold key that owns an imported response. Opening a citation now expands that fold, then scrolls to and highlights the source.
topics.title: Opening a citation expands folded imported responses

suggestion.reason: Makes provider setup UI in Settings and onboarding accurate.

topics.summary: Provider snapshots for CLI-owned installs set install and authenticate to false. Unavailable drivers stay unknown. Codex setup waits for the managed instance's authenticate capability.
topics.title: CLI-owned providers declare they have no in-app setup

suggestion.reason: It is a reliability and memory fix for the terminal server, a subsystem f5 has.

topics.summary: Each terminal output subscriber gets an 8 MiB mailbox. A subscriber that overflows it is released, then resubscribes and receives a bounded history snapshot followed by live output.
topics.title: Slow terminal clients no longer queue unbounded output

suggestion.reason: Diff panel bug fix that applies to f5.

topics.summary: A draft for a file that left the diff is cleared, along with its text and selected lines, so commenting on the remaining files is enabled again.
topics.title: Orphaned diff comment drafts no longer block commenting

suggestion.reason: Fixes PR watching on a forge that f5 supports. Reimplement it in f5's forge layer.

topics.summary: PR commit listings request files=false&verification=false, which shrinks pages from MB to KB. Watch polls on large PRs no longer fail.
topics.title: Watching large Forgejo/Gitea PRs no longer exceeds the output limit

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken check links in the PR hub for Forgejo and Gitea. Reimplement it in f5's forge layer.

topics.summary: Relative Actions check paths from Gitea and Forgejo are resolved against the pull request URL. Opening check details no longer fails.
topics.title: Gitea and Forgejo check details links open correctly

suggestion.reason: Fixes disk leakage in the preview browser, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Once a download is copied, its original is deleted on a best-effort basis, so long-lived browser profiles stop piling up files.
topics.title: Preview browser deletes the original download after saving a copy

suggestion.reason: Desktop shortcut fix.

topics.summary: Adds a hidden Cmd+Shift+= zoom accelerator. App zoom targets the registered main window, so a focused popup no longer receives it.
topics.title: Cmd+Plus zooms the app on macOS

suggestion.reason: Fixes cropped screenshot context in the composer.

topics.summary: SnapShot previews fit the full frame within 832×448 instead of a square crop. The desktop capture animation lands on the same fitted frame.
topics.title: SnapShot thumbnails show the whole screenshot

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong screenshots in the preview browser's annotation feature.
