topics.summary: Annotation screenshot crops keep their signed CSS bounds, check each target against the viewport and clip scaled edges outward. Annotations outside the viewport or with empty captures now report a screenshot failure.
topics.title: Offscreen preview annotations no longer attach unrelated screenshot strips

suggestion.reason: Fixes a race in thread launch with worktrees. Reimplement it in f5's launch path.

topics.summary: Cleanup interrupts the branch-rename fiber before forgetting a removed worktree. A late rename can no longer point the thread back at a deleted worktree path.
topics.title: Cancelling worktree setup stops the background branch rename

suggestion.reason: Terminal reliability fix. Reimplement the client-runtime part inside f5's layers.

topics.summary: The terminal manager remembers closed sessions and reports closed on a resumed attach. The client marks an attach as resumed after its first reply. An explicit open or restart still works.
topics.title: Reconnecting no longer reopens a closed terminal

suggestion.reason: Composer bug fix that applies to f5.

topics.summary: Retained chip payloads and editor undo history are reset together when the draft changes, so undo can't insert the previous draft's chip into another thread.
topics.title: Undo no longer restores a deleted chip from the previous draft

suggestion.reason: f5 has no scheduled-tasks subsystem.

topics.summary: Bound scheduled-task runs no longer pass the stored model selection, so they stop switching the thread back to the provider saved when the task was created.
topics.title: Thread-bound scheduled tasks use the thread's current provider

suggestion.reason: Mainly an iOS resume symptom in client-runtime, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: The connection supervisor clears the earlier failure once a session is established and does not record a lost live session as a failure. The fix targets iOS resume.
topics.title: A dropped session reads as Reconnecting, not Failed to connect

suggestion.reason: Observability improvement for ACP providers; applies only if f5 has the Linux cgroup wrapper.

topics.summary: Wrapper prints the non-executable target before exit 125, surfacing it in the process-exit error.
topics.title: ACP cgroup wrapper names rejected agent path on stderr

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Pi provider bug, and Pi is one of f5's providers. Reimplement it inside f5's provider layer.

topics.summary: A completed Pi discovery, including an empty one, now counts as the current model list, so models that are no longer offered are removed. Failed or interactive discovery still keeps the last known models.
topics.title: Pi model picker drops models from providers you logged out of

suggestion.reason: This only matters when there are several environments with a per-environment settings scope.

topics.summary: The settings scope project picker filters projects by checkouts on the selected environment, so it no longer offers a scope that is unavailable there.
topics.title: Settings project picker lists only projects in the chosen environment

suggestion.reason: The web McpAppFrame exists in f5. This fixes a trapping UX bug.

topics.summary: An MCP app frame can only request fullscreen after user activation inside the app, so apps can no longer go fullscreen on load or reopen right after exit. Exiting fullscreen still always works. The mobile part does not apply to f5.
topics.title: MCP apps enter fullscreen only after a user tap inside the app

suggestion.reason: Bug fix in opening folders from the desktop app, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Windows file-manager launches convert forward slashes to backslashes before calling explorer.exe, which reads '/' as a switch.
topics.title: Opening a folder in File Explorer on Windows lands on the right folder

suggestion.reason: Fixes OpenCode updates that look failed or keep being offered after an upgrade.

topics.summary: Snapshots expose installedVersion, which update advice and verification prefer over a borrowed server's stale version.
topics.title: OpenCode updates are verified against the installed CLI version

suggestion.reason: This is the client-runtime saved remote host compatibility flow, which is only used with multiple environments and relay.

topics.summary: updateOutdatedHost skips the self-update and re-enables the environment when the host already speaks the client's protocol.
topics.title: Update clears the block on a saved host that is already compatible
fix(mobile): keep composer within folded screen without leaving the thread (#18574)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop backend lifecycle bug.

topics.summary: DesktopBackendPool.register now provides the child scope after the factory context, so unregister really stops the instance. A disabled WSL backend is no longer restarted as if it had crashed.
topics.title: Disabling the WSL backend stops its supervisor
fix(android): space the New thread FAB 16dp from the edge and tab bar (#18578)

suggestion.reason: This is a small visual fix in the usage surface.

topics.summary: The reset/credit plate on a pooled usage bar is rendered only when it has a countdown or reset credits.
topics.title: Unstarted usage windows no longer show an empty reset badge

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix in settings sync. f5's useSettings.ts can hit the same repeated-save loop.

topics.summary: Older servers ignore migrateModelPreferences, so the client kept saving the same migration again and again. The web client now tries the migration once per connection generation, after preferences have loaded. The mobile part does not apply to f5.
topics.title: Model preferences migration no longer loops on older servers

suggestion.reason: Prevents settings data loss.

topics.summary: Saves reload settings.json from disk under the write lock before applying patches. Saves reject malformed JSON instead of overwriting it with defaults.
topics.title: Settings saves no longer revert external edits to settings.json

suggestion.reason: This is the upstream Lineage control. f5 keeps its own Agents panel.

topics.summary: Pending, running and waiting task details are kept until the task settles, so the active task no longer moves to Previous agents.
topics.title: Lineage shows a supervisor waiting on its worker as running

suggestion.reason: Small fix for a visible settings rendering bug. It applies only if f5 has a matching height animator.

topics.summary: AnimatedHeight clips its content while holdHeight is active, so taller content cannot spill over the dialog footer during a reload.
topics.title: Add-provider wizard content no longer overlaps the footer while loading

suggestion.reason: A Claude usage-limit recovery bug that can happen in f5's Claude adapter. It needs to be reimplemented there.

topics.summary: Reads the reset time from the blocked assistant's api_error_params.rate_limit_info when Claude suppresses an unchanged rate_limit_event, so automatic recovery keeps a reset time.
topics.title: Claude usage-limit reset times survive quick retries

topics.reason: Only affects the T3 Connect relay and cloud link.

suggestion.reason: Only affects the T3 Connect relay and cloud link.

topics.summary: A relay 401 for an expired environment link proof is now treated as retryable.
topics.title: T3 Connect retries a link rejected because its proof expired

suggestion.reason: Settings status fix for a provider f5 has.

topics.summary: Settings shows 'Installed · Sign-in not checked' in a neutral style instead of Needs attention when Antigravity's account access is unknown.
topics.title: Antigravity with unchecked sign-in shows a neutral status

suggestion.reason: Small visual fix in surfaces f5 has.

topics.summary: Icons beside wrapped text now align with the first line in the palette, warnings, diff comments, review-guide questions, settings, diagnostics and toasts.
topics.title: Icons line up with the first line of their text

suggestion.reason: This fixes a bug in the file preview panel.

topics.summary: Reopening a rendered markdown file preview, or editing the workspace, refreshes the signed asset URL. Images created after a cached failure now appear. Chat keeps its existing caching.
topics.title: Markdown file previews refresh embedded image assets

topics.reason: f5 does not have the scheduled tasks subsystem.

suggestion.reason: f5 does not have the scheduled tasks subsystem.

topics.summary: The scheduled task list reports the server's timezone. Settings and thread Automations labels show fixed-time tasks in that zone.
topics.title: Fixed-time scheduled tasks are labeled with the server timezone

suggestion.reason: Fork bug for Claude instances with a custom home, which f5 supports. Reimplement in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: When an instance's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR differs from the server's, the session fork runs through a history worker under the instance environment. It can then find the transcript.
topics.title: Forking a Claude thread works on instances with their own home

suggestion.reason: Fixes Cursor skills going missing from the $ picker, like the related node_modules fix.

topics.summary: Records each root's real path and skips roots already walked, so linked skill trees no longer use up the scan budget and leave the picker empty.
topics.title: Cursor skill discovery no longer scans a symlinked skills root twice

suggestion.reason: Fixes a failure to open the terminal for deeply nested subagent threads.

topics.summary: Terminal history filenames longer than 255 bytes use a SHA-256 hashed name, so terminals for nested subagent threads no longer fail with ENAMETOOLONG.
topics.title: Terminals open for threads with long ids

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Settings dead end with no way to recover on the page.

topics.summary: The environment choices are limited to the project's member environments. The unavailable state keeps the scope controls and offers Show all environments.
topics.title: Project settings no longer dead-ends on environments without the project

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git actions bug. The affected files exist in the fork.

topics.summary: When there are no uncommitted changes, the Push/Create PR default-branch dialog now disables the feature-branch option and says why. Before, it offered an option that always failed with a server error.
topics.title: Default-branch dialog disables 'check out feature branch' when the tree is clean

suggestion.reason: Fixes Usage → Limits showing stale readings after a refresh, a symptom f5's usage limits can have.

topics.summary: A probe that is strictly older keeps the published windows and their read time but updates metadata. Claude records when its usage request starts, so cached usage stops getting a fresh timestamp.
topics.title: Older usage probes no longer overwrite live usage limits

suggestion.reason: A new user-visible timeline capability that ships off by default. Port the web and desktop parts only.

topics.summary: Adds a preference, off by default, that renders inline and display math with lazy-loaded KaTeX in ChatMarkdown and keeps the TeX source copyable. The mobile parts don't apply.
topics.title: Opt-in LaTeX rendering in chat markdown

suggestion.reason: Fixes misleading text in settings. This applies if f5 has the Tailscale HTTPS row in its connections settings.

topics.summary: When Tailscale detection was skipped because Network access is off, the Tailscale HTTPS row in Settings → Connections now says 'Turn on Network access to detect Tailscale.'
topics.title: Tailscale HTTPS row says detection is off instead of 'Start Tailscale'

suggestion.reason: Fixes Grok showing as unavailable. Grok is an f5 provider.

topics.summary: The Grok ACP initialize probe timeout goes from 8s to 20s, so a CLI that starts slowly but works is no longer reported as failed.
topics.title: Grok readiness probe gives ACP initialize 20 seconds

suggestion.reason: Provider update bug fix. Reimplement in f5's provider layer, since packages/provider-* does not exist in f5.

topics.summary: Grok cask installs are compared against the cask version and updated with brew upgrade --cask. Casks that cannot be verified are manual-only, which avoids a second install from grok update.
topics.title: Homebrew-installed Grok updates through brew

suggestion.reason: Fixes Forgejo PR watch behavior in the forge surface.

topics.summary: Reads the base branch's required status contexts and marks those checks, so a failing optional check no longer blocks a pass.
topics.title: Forgejo PR watches pass once required checks pass

suggestion.reason: Fixes PR hub failures for restricted GitHub credentials.

topics.summary: On a plain REST 403 from GET /user, identity is checked through a GraphQL viewer query with the same credential, so every PR read is no longer blocked.
topics.title: GitHub PRs load for credentials that cannot read /user

suggestion.reason: Devices subsystem only.

topics.summary: Before opening an emulator, the device host checks ffmpeg and libx264 and returns an actionable error if either is missing.
topics.title: Android emulator open reports missing ffmpeg/libx264

suggestion.reason: Fixes a composer bug that deletes text the user typed.

topics.summary: A line counts as an empty list item only when whitespace follows the marker, so a bare marker typed without a space is kept.
topics.title: Enter after a bare "2." in the composer adds a line instead of deleting it

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale entries in the provider model picker.

topics.summary: ProviderRegistry replaces the ACP model list after any completed discovery probe, detected by nativeSessions, instead of only when auth is authenticated. Stale models and the default placeholder are removed.
topics.title: ACP agents that need no sign-in drop models they stopped advertising

suggestion.reason: A desktop reliability fix for Linux AppImage users.

topics.summary: Removes stale .mount_* entries from PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH and XDG_DATA_DIRS before the backend starts, so git and other subprocesses no longer fail with ENOTCONN.
topics.title: AppImage launches drop earlier launches' mount dirs from PATH

suggestion.reason: Fixes a forge pagination bug in the PR hub. It needs reimplementing in f5's layers because the source-control packages don't exist in the fork.

topics.summary: The listing cursor passes the IDs it has already delivered at the boundary timestamp, and Bitbucket excludes them in its API query. Load More no longer stalls when a full page of PRs shares one update timestamp.
topics.title: Bitbucket PR list Load More advances past PRs with the same update time

suggestion.reason: A small accessibility fix to surfaces f5 has.

topics.summary: Adds motion-safe: to the remaining status pulse and ping animations in thread rows, the sidebar, the connection dot, the chat header and preview tabs.
topics.title: Status dots stop animating when Reduce Motion is on

suggestion.reason: Fixes GitLab PR errors that were silently hidden.

topics.summary: Optional activity reads no longer treat auth, missing-tool and rate-limit failures as empty activity. Those errors reach the caller and the host backoff. Other failures still return partial activity.
topics.title: GitLab activity reads report authentication, missing glab and rate limits

suggestion.reason: The commit has no file changes. The behavior was delivered by a different upstream commit, which should be triaged separately.

topics.summary: The commit changes no files. Upstream says #20449 already contains this symlink containment behavior.
topics.title: File saves no longer follow symlinks out of the workspace (empty commit)

topics.reason: Scheduled tasks are an upstream-only subsystem that f5 does not have.

suggestion.reason: Scheduled tasks are an upstream-only subsystem that f5 does not have.

topics.summary: When accepting a webhook fails before dispatch, its relay deduplication claim is now released, so the relay's retry starts the task instead of being answered as a duplicate.
topics.title: Scheduled-task webhooks release their dedupe claim when acceptance fails

suggestion.reason: Fixes a PR hub panel state bug.

topics.summary: The selected PR detail tab is saved with each thread's PR surface, and the panel remounts when the thread changes. Another thread's tab no longer carries over.
topics.title: PR panel remembers its selected tab per thread

suggestion.reason: Speeds up and unblocks Stop for parents with follow-up subagent tasks; reimplement in f5's thread management.

topics.summary: stopDelegatedTasks skips child threads it has already stopped, so follow-up task rows no longer multiply Stop dispatches and projection reads exponentially.
topics.title: Stop visits each delegated child thread once

suggestion.reason: Small visual fix in the theme editor preview, part of settings.

topics.summary: Code renderers use the appearance being previewed, so highlight colors match a light or dark draft palette while it is edited.
topics.title: Code highlighting follows the theme editor's draft appearance

suggestion.reason: A one-line keyboard accessibility fix, not a tool-row redesign.

topics.summary: Tool rows handle Enter and Space only when the row itself is focused, so nested controls such as Open diff activate instead of collapsing the row.
topics.title: Buttons inside expanded tool rows work from the keyboard

suggestion.reason: SSH tunnels to remote environments are part of upstream's multi-environment support.

topics.summary: Forks a stderr drain for the tunnel's lifetime, keeping a bounded 16 KiB tail, so a full pipe can't stall forwarding.
topics.title: SSH tunnels keep draining stderr after readiness
fix(mobile): keep queued-edit context in its draft (#18834)

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale PR feedback for watching agents. The fix has to be reimplemented in f5's PR watch layer.

topics.summary: Cached reply pages are refreshed after 30 minutes, or 10 minutes without a fingerprint, and on any new signal. Edits to later-page replies no longer stay stale, and partial pagination clears the cache.
topics.title: PR watches refresh cached review replies
fix(mobile): preserve line counts for withheld pull request hunks (#18836)
fix(mobile): serialize initial device identity creation (#18837)

suggestion.reason: Relay webhook infrastructure only.

topics.summary: After the held-webhook inbox is cleared, the relay inbox no longer delivers or retries the remaining requests from a batch it had already fetched.
topics.title: Relay stops held webhook deliveries after the inbox is cleared

suggestion.reason: Composer bug fix that prevents lost or wrongly restored prompts. It only applies if f5's composer has the stash drawer, which these upstream files suggest may not be the case.

topics.summary: While the stash drawer was open, Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+Backspace could restore or delete a stashed prompt even when the user was typing in a dialog or another input. Stash keys now only run for events from the composer, the drawer or the stash badge.
topics.title: Stash drawer shortcuts only act in the composer and drawer

suggestion.reason: This fixes data loss in f5's composer stash flow.

topics.summary: Stashing a prompt now saves its thread-context records with it. They are cleared from the source only after the write succeeds and are restored into the main composer draft, so restored prompts no longer contain unresolved references.
topics.title: Stashed prompts keep their thread-context chips

suggestion.reason: Fixes a race in f5's composer file mentions.

topics.summary: Each path suggestion carries its environment, workspace and query. Click, Enter and Tab check these against the live editor, so an old result can no longer replace the new query with the wrong file.
topics.title: Composer rejects file suggestions from an older query
fix(mobile): lock the composer while a queued edit saves (#18846)

suggestion.reason: Accessibility fix for f5's sidebar.

topics.summary: A collapsed offcanvas sidebar becomes inert, and focus moves to the external toggle. Expanding the sidebar restores keyboard access.
topics.title: Collapsed sidebar controls are removed from keyboard navigation

suggestion.reason: Fixes keyboard accessibility in the command palette.

topics.summary: When there is no composer, finalFocus returns true so Base UI restores the earlier focus. The palette input defers its own focus by one frame. Escape from Settings search no longer drops focus to the page body.
topics.title: Command palette returns focus to the previous field when no composer is mounted

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance improvement. This needs reimplementing in f5's provider registry.

topics.summary: The interval loop no longer probes disabled provider instances or republishes their status, which saves a large status push every cycle. Manual refresh and enabling a provider still probe it.
topics.title: Periodic health checks skip disabled providers

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for PR sync, which f5 has.

topics.summary: PR summary and stack reads are grouped by project plus PR. A checkout or credential failure in one project no longer blocks updates for others, and each failed project keeps its own pending retry.
topics.title: Pull request sync reads each project separately

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading error message in desktop SnapShot setup.

topics.summary: The test-mac-capture error now says whether finding or capturing the window failed, and whether it timed out or exited, instead of 'Could not set up the GNOME extension.'
topics.title: Failed macOS SnapShot test capture names the failing step, not GNOME

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in panels. RightPanelTabs exists in f5.

topics.summary: Right-panel tabs cancel the middle-button mouseup as well as mousedown, so on Linux, closing a tab no longer pastes the primary selection into the composer.
topics.title: Middle-click closing a panel tab no longer pastes the primary selection

suggestion.reason: Only changes T3 Connect wording.

topics.summary: Changes the wording of the T3 Connect network-blocking hint.
topics.title: T3 Connect network hint no longer suggests a phone hotspot

suggestion.reason: Fixes data loss in worktree setup. Check that f5's thread launch has the same fallback to the project root.

topics.summary: Thread launch skips the setup action when there is no worktree path. Before, setup scripts like 'ln -sf $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env' destroyed the real file.
topics.title: Worktree setup actions no longer run for threads in the main checkout

suggestion.reason: Settings usability bug fix.

topics.summary: Jumping to a search result in a collapsed section scrolls again after the opening animation, so the row ends up visible.
topics.title: Settings search reaches rows in collapsed sections
fix(mobile): iOS builds on Xcode 27.0 no longer fail on 27.1-only hinge APIs (#18913)

suggestion.reason: Small composer UX fix that keeps usage-limit recovery controls reachable.

topics.summary: Urgent, error and warning banners now take the front slot of the composer banner stack ahead of activity banners such as goals. Usage-limit recovery controls are no longer hidden.
topics.title: Urgent and warning composer notices rank ahead of activity banners

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Pi provider conflict with other extensions. Pi is an f5 provider.

topics.summary: When Pi offers prompt sections, the guidance goes into a t3_code_orchestration section. Older Pi builds, and prompts an earlier extension already forced, still get the appended-prompt fallback.
topics.title: Pi orchestration guidance no longer overrides other extensions' prompt changes

suggestion.reason: Small panel visual fix; apply to f5's equivalent right-panel shell if it has a maximized state.

topics.summary: Drops left border on the inline right panel when maximized.
topics.title: Maximized right panel no longer doubles sidebar border

suggestion.reason: Makes lower pull requests in long badge lists reachable again.

topics.summary: The linked-PR tooltip list is capped at the available height and scrolls internally. Focus outlines stay inside the list. This covers both sidebar and composer badges.
topics.title: Long PR badge lists stay inside the viewport
fix(mobile): Android thread pane no longer ends short after switching threads (#18963)

suggestion.reason: Changes the upstream Tiptap rich-text composer document, which the fork does not have.

topics.summary: Composer lists get gutters sized to the prompt font and the widest marker, using item marker-width metadata.
topics.title: Composer list markers no longer clip in wider prompt fonts

suggestion.question: Does f5 offer remote server self-update from the client, so that this disconnect fix would apply?
suggestion.reason: Remote server self-update through the cloud boot service is upstream cloud infrastructure that f5 does not have.

topics.summary: The self-update progress stream detaches the update from the RPC stream's scope, so a dropped WebSocket no longer interrupts the runtime download.
topics.title: A remote server update keeps running when the client disconnects

suggestion.reason: Fixes a broken rewind action in the timeline and checkpoints. The projection part has to be reimplemented in f5's layers.

topics.summary: Edit from here targets the ready checkpoint of the previous visible run instead of ordinal minus one. It also works for paged prompts and stopped resends, and stale edits are rejected before dispatch.
topics.title: Edit from here works after a previous rewind

suggestion.reason: Fixes duplicate editor launches.

topics.summary: Open-in handlers skip events that were already handled, and thread details yields the shortcut to a visible file preview. The editor no longer launches several times.
topics.title: Cmd+O opens the editor only once

suggestion.reason: Visual fix for the Files and Diff trees, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The Pierre tree theme uses native text-overflow ellipsis and hides the overlay marker, so clipped letters no longer show under the ellipsis.
topics.title: Long file names in the file tree truncate cleanly

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Codex provider startup failure on macOS. The affected files exist in the fork.

topics.summary: .DS_Store is now treated as a shadow-local file, so macOS Finder metadata no longer causes CodexShadowHomeEntryConflictError.
topics.title: Finder .DS_Store files no longer block Codex shadow-home setup

suggestion.reason: A composer queue UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Queue previews convert assistant citations to plain text. Editing a queued message still uses the original text.
topics.title: Queued follow-ups show quoted text instead of citation links
fix(mobile): show assistant quotes as text in the queue sheet (#19007)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stuck state in delegation and thread send, which f5 appears to have. Reimplement outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: A follow-up task bound to a running child run with no task of its own now survives the run's terminal write. The parent no longer shows 'Waiting on subagent' forever.
topics.title: A steered send into a subagent no longer leaves its task stuck running
fix(mobile): compact Dynamic Island opens the Live Activity's thread (#19022)

suggestion.reason: Fixes timeline order after a Codex steer. Reimplement outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: The first streaming update of a held assistant or reasoning item reserves its position. A steer-interrupted Codex draft no longer appears as the turn's final answer.
topics.title: Held assistant drafts keep their timeline position when flushed at turn end

suggestion.reason: Reduces log noise for the PR hub and forges. f5 has a SourceControlProviderRegistry equivalent.

topics.summary: The stand-in 'unknown' source control provider now returns an empty list from listChangeRequests instead of an error. This stops the 'PR lookup failed' warnings that flooded the server log for self-hosted or remoteless repos.
topics.title: Repos on unrecognized hosts stop logging a PR-lookup warning on every refresh
fix(mobile): resize quota bars when filtering environments (#19031)

suggestion.reason: Mobile build only.

topics.summary: Patches expo-sharing so the share extension gets its own Info.plist reference.
topics.title: iOS builds work on Xcode 27.2
fix(mobile): Browser address bar stays on one line on iOS (#19042)

suggestion.reason: A small visual fix in the composer notice stack, if the fork has an equivalent component.

topics.summary: The wrapper that expands stacked notices now uses overflow-y-clip instead of overflow-hidden. This stops the right border of a notice from being cut off at fractional display scales.
topics.title: Stacked composer notices keep their right border at fractional scales

suggestion.reason: The palette advertised shortcuts that did nothing.

topics.summary: With the palette open, a new-thread shortcut runs the displayed palette item. IME composition is skipped, and the palette input counts as editable focus.
topics.title: New-thread shortcuts work while the command palette lists them

suggestion.reason: f5 has delegate_task subagents, so the wrong summary can appear there too. Rebuild it in f5's subagent projection.

topics.summary: subagentResultForRun picks the message linked to the assistant_message turn item with the highest ordinal, not the newest updatedAt. OpenCode children now report their final message, not their first.
topics.title: A delegated task's result comes from its newest turn item
fix(web): Mod+T opens the tab menu while a pull request tab is open (#19065)

suggestion.reason: Clearer error for the Pi provider, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: When Pi rejects set_model, the error names the model and Pi's reason, and explains that text generation runs with --no-extensions, so extension models are unavailable.
topics.title: Pi text generation says why it cannot load a model

suggestion.reason: Layout fix for the terminal drawer, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Drawer height is also capped by the chat column minus the header and the composer. The saved height comes back when space allows. Right-panel terminals keep the window cap.
topics.title: Terminal drawer no longer pushes the composer into the header

suggestion.reason: Visual fix in DiffPanel.tsx which exists in fork.

topics.summary: Head-ref group gets a minimum width and base-ref button can shrink so the arrow no longer overlaps.
topics.title: Diff panel keeps head ref visible when narrow

suggestion.reason: A UX fix for the Muse provider, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: When Muse reports a model's raw muse- id as its label, the label is turned into title case, e.g. 'Muse Wonder Full 1.0'. Model selection still uses the original id.
topics.title: Muse model picker shows readable names

suggestion.reason: A storage migration for upstream's orchestration-v2 records, which f5 does not have. Behavior does not change.

topics.summary: Migration 64 converts V2 linkedPullRequest fields into pullRequests arrays and removes the legacy query branch.
topics.title: Migrate legacy V2 thread pull request links

topics.reason: The change is a mobile app optimization. The client-runtime projection it touches does not exist in f5.

suggestion.reason: The change is a mobile app optimization. The client-runtime projection it touches does not exist in f5.

topics.summary: This caches the mobile thread feed build and adds incremental projection updates in client-runtime.
topics.title: Mobile streamed chunks cost about 8x less JS on long threads

suggestion.reason: Gives clearer failure messages for the Claude provider.

topics.summary: When a Claude turn ends with terminal_reason api_error, the result text starting with 'API Error:' is sanitized, capped at 500 characters and shown instead of a generic message.
topics.title: Claude API errors show the final result's error text

suggestion.reason: Fixes a truncated provider catalog in Settings.

topics.summary: An empty search requests up to 512 agents instead of 20. Typed searches keep the 20-result default for compatibility.
topics.title: Add provider lists every compatible ACP Registry agent

suggestion.reason: Fixes Code Mode calls failing with a bare Codex release binary.

topics.summary: Local Codex resolution requires an executable codex-code-mode-host next to the native binary and otherwise uses the managed install. Launchers and shims keep their existing probe behavior.
topics.title: Local Codex binaries without codex-code-mode-host are skipped

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong provider update action. This needs reimplementing in f5's provider maintenance layer.

topics.summary: A mise-owned launcher that sits in a native install path no longer offers the provider's native updater. Ownership checks run first.
topics.title: Provider updates respect mise ownership in native install locations

suggestion.reason: Fixes session import skipping long Claude sessions, a flow f5 has.

topics.summary: The scanner keeps only visible Claude user and assistant records within the 32 MiB budget, and folds session id, title, model and cwd separately.
topics.title: Long Claude sessions made mostly of tool records can be imported

suggestion.reason: Fixes project defaults and settings files that fail to load. The changed file exists in f5.

topics.summary: Line and block comments are stripped in one string-aware pass and replaced with whitespace. A // inside a block comment no longer corrupts parsing.
topics.title: JSONC block comments containing URLs no longer break project defaults

suggestion.reason: Makes the web client installable; use f5's own app name.

topics.summary: Adds name and short_name to manifest.webmanifest.
topics.title: Name the web app manifest so Chrome offers install
fix(mobile): pulling to refresh a pull request fetches current checks (#19177)

suggestion.reason: Fixes corruption in generated commit messages. f5 has git commit generation.

topics.summary: When a generated commit subject is truncated to 72 units, it now keeps whole graphemes. Commit history no longer gets lone surrogates or broken emoji.
topics.title: Generated commit subjects no longer split Unicode characters

suggestion.reason: Applies only to the upstream Tiptap rich-text composer.

topics.summary: The Tiptap italic extension uses asterisk-only input rules, so identifiers containing underscores are not italicized.
topics.title: Rich text composer keeps typed underscores literal

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for the Muse provider, which f5 has.

topics.summary: An idle Muse host failure keeps the event stream alive, so the next registration launches a replacement host. The session manager re-resumes threads whose provider is in error instead of reusing a dead host.
topics.title: Muse relaunches a host that died between turns

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stuck Claude run that blocks threads in f5.

topics.summary: A continuation with no root wake activity completes after two minutes, so later messages are no longer blocked until a server restart.
topics.title: Claude wake run settles when Claude never opens the wake turn

suggestion.reason: User-visible fix on Windows. client-runtime does not exist in f5, so the helper must be reimplemented.

topics.summary: Copy actions for file chips, media menus, the workspace header and file previews format paths in the host's path style, so Windows paths have backslashes. Only the web part applies.
topics.title: Copied file paths use the host's native separators

suggestion.reason: Small display fix if f5 groups projects by repository identity; reimplement without source-control-core.

topics.summary: Grouped project names use the remote URL's capitalization while keeping lowercase grouping keys.
topics.title: Preserve repository display casing in grouped project names

suggestion.reason: Improves an error in the git publish flow, which f5 has.

topics.summary: When publishRepository creates the repo and adds the remote but the push fails, the dialog explains this and gives a reason-specific fix (e.g. authentication, switch to HTTPS) instead of a generic error.
topics.title: Publishing explains why the first push failed after creating the repo

suggestion.reason: A measurable desktop SnapShot performance gain (several ms per capture) in a surface f5 has, with no behavior change.

topics.summary: When SnapShot accessibility is on, the desktop reads the captured PNG's size from its header instead of decoding every pixel again. The rounded, minimum-one fallback to logical bounds is kept.
topics.title: SnapShot accessibility reads PNG dimensions from the header instead of decoding

suggestion.reason: Fixes desktop window tiling that users can hit on scaled displays.

topics.summary: The minimum window width drops from 840 to 600, including for saved bounds. Below the sidebar plus content floor, the sidebar becomes a sheet, and widening the window closes it.
topics.title: Desktop window can tile to half-screen on scaled displays
fix(mobile): long commands no longer freeze Android work-log taps (#19238)
fix(mobile): composer buttons stay visible with animations removed (#19239)
fix(mobile): bound huge native review diff payloads (#19240)

suggestion.reason: Only affects the mobile app.

topics.summary: A react-native-image-viewing patch commits the gesture state when a pinch is interrupted.
topics.title: Android image viewer keeps panning after an interrupted pinch

suggestion.reason: UX fix in f5's usage settings surface.

topics.summary: Input, Output and Cache price cells in Custom model prices ignore keystrokes and pastes that would not form a number. Exponent form stays allowed for very small saved rates.
topics.title: Custom model price cells accept only numbers

suggestion.reason: T3 Connect linking only.

topics.summary: The link-proof service allows the WSL NAT request host for desktop-bootstrap sessions.
topics.title: T3 Connect links from desktop when the backend runs in WSL

suggestion.reason: Build-script fix for developers with no end-user behavior change.

topics.summary: createBuildConfig sets publish to null by default, so electron-builder stops inferring a GitHub publisher from GH_TOKEN and crashing on local builds.
topics.title: Local desktop builds no longer crash when a GitHub token is exported
fix(mobile): keep the composer's draft and typing after answering a question (#19281)

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: The mobile work-log shimmer runs on React Native's native driver instead of Reanimated.
topics.title: Android no longer freezes when going back from a running thread

suggestion.reason: A measurable responsiveness improvement for desktop.

topics.summary: Recurring topology refreshes use asynchronous IPC and a cached snapshot instead of synchronous IPC. A slow main-process reply can no longer stall typing.
topics.title: Desktop topology polling no longer blocks the renderer

suggestion.reason: Fixes approvals that flash or get stuck for Muse, a provider f5 has.

topics.summary: Approvals for Full access workflow children stay hidden while their automatic answer is in flight. They appear only if the answer fails. Snapshots and the waiting status count only requests that were shown.
topics.title: Muse workflow child approvals no longer flash in Full access

suggestion.reason: Fixes prompt deep links. Port it only if f5 has the prompt-link handling; the upstream files are absent here.

topics.summary: ThreadLinkPrompt now acts only when the location pathname is its own thread route. A t3code://new?prompt link opened during navigation no longer drops the prompt into the current thread or strips the link.
topics.title: A prompt link opened from a thread no longer lands in that thread

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in a usage source f5 supports.

topics.summary: Management URLs are resolved relative to the hub URL, so a hub behind a reverse proxy at a subpath can be added as a usage source.
topics.title: CLIProxyAPI usage hubs served under a path keep their path

suggestion.reason: A forge-detection fix in shared/sourceControl.ts, which exists in f5.

topics.summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud data-residency hosts (<tenant>.ghe.com) are now classified as GitHub, so PR status and thread settling work for those repositories.
topics.title: *.ghe.com remotes are detected as GitHub

suggestion.reason: This fixes a terminal bug where pasted text was duplicated.

topics.summary: Within one gesture, the terminal records the text it sent so the matching native paste event is consumed rather than pasted again. The gesture ends on key or modifier release or on blur, including when macOS omits the V keyup.
topics.title: Terminal paste shortcut sends text only once

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for the OpenCode provider. It matches the Codex fix in pr-18329.

topics.summary: OpenCode's shared server scope requests OOMPolicy=continue when systemd supports it, so one OOM-killed tool no longer disconnects every OpenCode thread.
topics.title: A tool killed for memory no longer stops the shared OpenCode server

suggestion.reason: Fixes file-name corruption in shared/gitPatchPath, which exists in f5. The change is one line.

topics.summary: When the git patch path helper unescapes a quoted file name, it no longer strips a leading U+FEFF as if it were a byte-order mark. That bug corrupted file names and could attach a revision key to the wrong file.
topics.title: Quoted Git file names keep a leading U+FEFF

suggestion.reason: Fixes a reliability bug in the preview browser's cookie import.

topics.summary: encrypted_value is cast to BLOB in SQL, so one TEXT value no longer aborts the whole Chromium cookie import.
topics.title: Browser cookie import reads Chromium cookies stored as text

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in providers that use ACP. Reimplement it in the fork's ACP adapter.

topics.summary: When a message starts with '/', the runtime-instructions block is left out, so ACP agents can expand native slash or skill commands.
topics.title: ACP slash-command prompts are sent as a single text block

suggestion.reason: Small UI fix in the PR hub.

topics.summary: The checks popover's scroll area extends into the padding, so the overlay scrollbar sits in a gutter instead of over the Details links.
topics.title: PR checks scrollbar no longer covers Details links

suggestion.reason: Fixes the Claude provider's context meter in f5. Reimplement it in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter now tracks message_delta.usage. Anthropic-compatible backends that send zeros at message start and real counts in the final delta no longer leave the context meter at 0%.
topics.title: Claude context meter reads usage from stream message deltas
fix(mobile): Android review diff scrolls to the end of long lines (#19431)

suggestion.reason: Usage panel capability for Claude, a provider f5 has. Without it, Enterprise users see no limits.

topics.summary: An enabled Claude account spending budget, or enabled extra usage, maps to a monthly percentage window. It prefers spend amounts and falls back to extra_usage amounts or utilization. Before, Enterprise accounts without rolling quotas showed no limits.
topics.title: Claude Enterprise monthly spending budgets show as a usage window

suggestion.reason: Measurable typing performance fix in the composer.

topics.summary: Fences over 2,000 characters keep their mapped colors while typing and re-highlight after a 300 ms pause. Short fences still highlight immediately. A theme change refreshes right away.
topics.title: Long composer code blocks no longer re-highlight on every keystroke

topics.reason: Only affects relay/tunnel cloudflared resolution, which f5 does not ship.

suggestion.reason: Only affects relay/tunnel cloudflared resolution, which f5 does not ship.

topics.summary: The relay's cloudflared resolver now reads PATH from the live host environment instead of the cached Config, so a service-started server can find cloudflared after PATH hydration.
topics.title: Relay finds cloudflared using the hydrated login PATH

suggestion.reason: Fix is in upstream's ProseMirror/Tiptap composer serializer, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: The rich-text serializer writes a blank line between a blockquote and a following non-empty paragraph, so Markdown no longer treats the comment as a lazy continuation of the quote.
topics.title: A comment under a composer quote no longer joins the quote

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken keyboard editing in the preview browser, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Native menu editing shortcuts are enabled based on whether the guest itself is focused with a focused frame, not getFocusedWebContents(). Cmd+V/C/X/A/Z now work in older tabs.
topics.title: Paste and other editing shortcuts work in every preview browser tab

suggestion.reason: Fixes subagents stuck at Running in the Claude adapter. f5 can hit the same symptom; reimplement outside orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: When the Claude CLI exits without a final task notification, plain background agents are settled the same way workflows already are. An unexpected exit fails them, and Stop cancels them. Cleanup uses the exiting query's own last turn.
topics.title: Claude background agents settle when their process exits

suggestion.reason: Fixes a race that can drop skills from the composer menus, which is a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Each in-flight provider and directory scan now has an ownership token. A forced scan takes ownership, so an older scan can no longer publish over its newer skills results.
topics.title: Newer forced workspace scans keep their skills inventory

suggestion.reason: Fixes a desktop startup delay on Windows, and f5 has the same shell environment probe.

topics.summary: The Windows environment probe's PowerShell candidates now share a single 5-second monotonic budget, so the probe can no longer wait 5 seconds per candidate. A spawn failure still falls back to the next candidate.
topics.title: A slow PowerShell profile delays Windows startup by 5 s, not 10

suggestion.reason: A small composer bug fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: When a custom answer moves back to the composer, only the context records it still references are copied. Deleted chips no longer come back after a reload.
topics.title: Deleted answer chips no longer come back after picking an option

suggestion.reason: Fixes Claude skill invocation, a bug that can happen in f5.

topics.summary: When a prompt names several skills, each earlier user-only skill gets a user-invocation note and its SKILL.md path. The last skill is still dispatched natively.
topics.title: Claude no longer refuses earlier user-only skills in a prompt

suggestion.reason: Fixes service configuration being lost on updates. f5 has the background service.

topics.summary: The launcher reads an optional <T3CODE_HOME>/service.env at startup and passes it to all children. Launcher-owned variables stay protected, and updates no longer lose custom environment variables.
topics.title: Background service keeps custom environment across updates via service.env

suggestion.reason: Fixes a reliability bug in the MCP tools available to agents in long-lived threads.

topics.summary: Expired MCP credentials stay registered and cannot authenticate, and the next provider turn renews them. Before, threads idle past 24 hours lost T3 tools. Explicit revocation still removes them.
topics.title: t3-code tools work again after a thread sits idle for a day

topics.reason: Affects only T3 Connect cloud credentials.

suggestion.reason: Affects only T3 Connect cloud credentials.

topics.summary: Refreshing and persisting the credential are protected from shutdown interruption. Permanent refresh failures tell the user to run t3 connect login.
topics.title: T3 Connect keeps rotated credentials during shutdown

suggestion.reason: Visual fix to the model picker; it applies only if f5 uses the same LegendList patch.

topics.summary: The LegendList patch measures initial web layout with offset sizes, which ignore transforms such as a popup's scale animation.
topics.title: Model picker no longer jumps at the end of its open animation

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for CLI updates.

topics.summary: Release index requests send a configured GitHub token, so pagination no longer runs out of the unauthenticated rate limit.
topics.title: t3 update uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN for release lookups

suggestion.reason: Fixes the provider update UX in settings for Windows users. Reimplement it in f5's maintenance resolver.

topics.summary: On Windows, Claude Code installed with WinGet is detected and marked manual-update only. Settings no longer shows an Update button that runs a no-op 'claude update'.
topics.title: WinGet Claude installs are treated as manual-update only

suggestion.reason: Context handoff is an upstream-only subsystem.

topics.summary: The Context handoff pending preview checks provider eligibility, including project overrides.
topics.title: No pending handoff for a provider the next send would skip

suggestion.reason: cliArgs exists in the fork. This fixes Codex and Claude launch-argument parsing.

topics.summary: Outside quotes, the tokenizer treats \" and \' as literal characters, so following flags are no longer absorbed into a malformed value.
topics.title: Escaped quotes in provider launch arguments stay literal

suggestion.reason: Fixes reveal behavior on Windows and in WSL for the desktop app.

topics.summary: Reveal checks the default Directory shell verb. When a replacement file manager is registered, it opens the containing folder through the shell. Stock Windows keeps selecting the file in Explorer.
topics.title: Reveal opens the default Windows file manager

suggestion.reason: Improves the f5 diff panel.

topics.summary: File folds live in a session-only store keyed by environment, thread and diff scope, so switching tabs no longer resets them. A reload restores the defaults.
topics.title: Diff panel keeps collapsed files when switching right-panel tabs

suggestion.reason: Fixes usage-limit recovery for Claude, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Replay picks the latest meaningful result, so a later empty task-notification success no longer hides a quota failure needed for usage-limit recovery.
topics.title: Buffered Claude usage-limit failures are kept

suggestion.reason: Tiptap composer only.

topics.summary: Citation node wrapper uses the shared chip class for vertical centering.
topics.title: Citation pills line up with other composer chips

suggestion.reason: Fixes a stale diff in the Changes panel.

topics.summary: A settled cached preview is revalidated when the panel becomes visible, so external workspace edits show. A mutation refresh counts as that revalidation.
topics.title: Reopening the Changes panel refreshes its diff

suggestion.reason: A desktop reliability fix. The lock call does not depend on Clerk, so f5 can add it to its own startup.

topics.summary: The desktop app requests Electron's single-instance lock on every platform before it starts up, and quits if another copy holds the lock. Launching with open -n no longer starts a second backend on the same home directory.
topics.title: macOS no longer starts a duplicate backend on relaunch

suggestion.reason: Fixes a PR hub bug where GitHub App credentials fail to read whole PRs. f5 has GitHub forge support, so reimplement this in f5's layer.

topics.summary: When the only GraphQL errors are FORBIDDEN on a requested reviewer, detail and review-thread reads retry once with zero requested reviewers, so the PR loads and watches keep running.
topics.title: GitHub PRs load when GitHub refuses a requested reviewer

suggestion.reason: Fixes picker choices that fail at startup for ACP agents and Grok, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: Discovery, current selection, capability checks, startup writes and custom-model validation all use the first model-category select. Grok uses the same selector. A model offered in the picker no longer fails session startup.
topics.title: ACP model discovery and selection use the same config option

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: The mobile Browser tab menu gets a Close tab action.
topics.title: Mobile Browser page can close tabs

suggestion.reason: Makes an f5 setting take effect for provider maintenance.

topics.summary: The Homebrew registry request is made lazily, so turning off update checks is honored. When checks are on, versions are compared against the owning formula or cask.
topics.title: Homebrew installs skip brew info when update checks are off

suggestion.reason: Fixes queue behavior around usage limits for Claude threads. Reimplement it in f5's Claude adapter, not orchestration-v2.

topics.summary: When Claude reports compact_result failed, the run is marked failed even though Claude sends a success result. The usage-limit guard then holds queued messages instead of starting them into the same limit.
topics.title: A /compact stopped by the Claude usage limit is recorded as failed

suggestion.reason: Fixes leftover temp files on Linux desktop launches.

topics.summary: The icon installers read the bytes from asar and write the persistent icon only when it is missing or different. Before, Electron's copyFile left temporary extracted files behind.
topics.title: Linux launches no longer leave temporary icon copies
fix(mobile): Android composer paste no longer drops trailing text (#19590)

suggestion.reason: Layout bug fix in the shared standalone page used by pairing/auth pages, which f5 can hit on short windows.

topics.summary: StandalonePage now owns its scroll and uses safe centering, so on short windows the card's bottom (Approve/Deny buttons) is reachable instead of clipped.
topics.title: Standalone sign-in and pairing pages scroll when the card is taller than the window

suggestion.reason: A performance and reliability fix in git commit, which f5 has.

topics.summary: When the user supplies a commit message, prepareCommitContext skips generating the staged patch. This saves a git process, and a broken text converter can no longer block the commit.
topics.title: Commits with a user-written message skip the unused diff

suggestion.reason: Removes growing CPU cost on long ACP agent logs.

topics.summary: Terminal state tracks the output's UTF-8 byte length and measures only appended text. When the 16 MiB cap is hit, whole leading characters are dropped.
topics.title: ACP terminal output no longer re-encodes the whole buffer per chunk

suggestion.reason: Only affects T3 Connect relay signing.

topics.summary: stableStringify sorts keys by code unit instead of localeCompare, so devices can connect to hosts with a Latvian, Lithuanian, Basque or Azerbaijani locale.
topics.title: T3 Connect DPoP thumbprints are the same on every host locale

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance improvement for f5's ACP providers; reimplement in f5's ACP adapter.

topics.summary: The first text is emitted at once, later chunks are combined into scheduled 50 ms snapshots, and the full text is flushed when a segment closes. This removes the quadratic event growth for Grok, Antigravity and registry agents.
topics.title: ACP streamed text is coalesced into 50 ms snapshots

suggestion.reason: Fixes file-link resolution on Windows in the timeline and terminal.

topics.summary: The Windows home-path regex becomes case-insensitive, so ~/ links resolve when the cwd uses 'users'.
topics.title: ~/ file links resolve with any casing of Windows Users folder

suggestion.reason: Fixes slash commands disappearing for f5's OpenCode provider.

topics.summary: A command probe that times out reports pending instead of caching an empty list, so cached commands are kept and the probe is retried.
topics.title: OpenCode workspace commands are retried after a probe timeout

suggestion.reason: f5's Claude provider can hit the same restart race. Reimplement the fix in f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: Before resuming, the adapter checks the session transcript. If it has only metadata lines and no user or assistant message, resume fails, so a fresh native session is bound instead of each turn failing with 'No conversation found'.
topics.title: Claude sessions that never saved a message are replaced instead of failing every turn

suggestion.reason: T3 Connect relay authentication only.

topics.summary: DPoP proofs accept timestamps up to 300 s off in either direction, and relay replay retention is extended to match.
topics.title: T3 Connect tolerates a host clock a few seconds behind
fix(mobile): no-project drafts name No project in the project picker (#19641)

suggestion.reason: Fixes misleading resource attribution, an observability improvement, if f5 has the resource telemetry view.

topics.summary: The Electron ancestry check stops at the server PID, so provider and terminal subprocesses appear under Backend + agents instead of Desktop.
topics.title: Resource monitor counts backend child processes as backend, not desktop

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix. Runs stuck as Running can happen in f5's equivalent subsystem.

topics.summary: When the failed-terminal write fails, it is retried with exponential backoff capped at 30 s, so the run no longer stays Running after storage recovers.
topics.title: Run failures are persisted once storage recovers
fix(mobile): Browser menu pastes the phone's clipboard into the page (#19648)

suggestion.reason: Fixes server self-updates failing on slow connections.

topics.summary: The pinned runtime download times out after one minute without headers or a new chunk, instead of a 10-minute total cap. Stalled transfers clean up and release the lock.
topics.title: Slow server update downloads no longer fail at a 10-minute cap

suggestion.reason: A visible timeline bug on long threads.

topics.summary: The timeline keeps LegendList's measured initial end target when a list first mounts on a thread, instead of replacing it with an estimated scrollToEnd offset. Saved reading positions keep working.
topics.title: Threads open at the newest message instead of far above it

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for desktop SSH connections, if f5 has SSH environments.

topics.summary: A retry adopts the interrupted desktop IPC setup and exchanges its credential once, instead of starting a second setup and leaving the first credential unused.
topics.title: Retrying an interrupted SSH pairing reuses the unfinished setup

suggestion.reason: Fixes a composer bug that f5 users can hit when typing paths.

topics.summary: A slash word that contains a second slash counts as a path, so typing it no longer opens an empty 'No matching command.' menu. The check covers the whole word, even when the caret sits before the second slash.
topics.title: Paths like /tmp/build.sh no longer open the slash menu

suggestion.reason: A measurable git performance improvement.

topics.summary: Turns off core.preloadIndex for the disposable intent-to-add index used for exact untracked totals.
topics.title: Untracked change totals use less CPU

suggestion.reason: Triage did not classify this commit; review it manually.
suggestion.triageError: omitted by triage

topics.title: fix(web): name the remote host and checked path when media is not found (#19677)

suggestion.reason: Clearer error messages for Cursor users. Reimplement it in f5's Cursor adapter.

topics.summary: The Cursor SDK's model rejection is classified into a clear error. The message explains that the model must be in the account catalog and points API-key models to OpenCode, instead of showing a generic retryable error.
topics.title: Cursor explains when a selected model is not in the account catalog

topics.reason: Built around the hosted app, Clerk sign-in and cloud computer discovery.

suggestion.reason: Built around the hosted app, Clerk sign-in and cloud computer discovery.

topics.summary: Hosted web clients enter the app after settings hydrate, and the empty home recommends Clerk sign-in and account-computer discovery.
topics.title: Hosted app skips setup and recommends signing in

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible startup stall in f5's terminal for fish users.

topics.summary: Terminal spawn env adds no-query-term to fish_features unless query-term is already set, so fish 4.1+ no longer waits for a DA1 reply before the renderer attaches. On Windows, an inherited key is updated case-insensitively.
topics.title: fish shells in the integrated terminal no longer stall 10s on startup

suggestion.reason: f5 has automatic pull, so it can show the same stale Changes state. Rebuild inside f5's VCS status layer.

topics.summary: If an automatic pull was attempted and then failed, the broadcaster reads local status again and publishes it instead of the snapshot from before the pull. If that reread fails, the error goes to the caller or to polling backoff.
topics.title: Git status refreshes after an automatic pull fails

topics.reason: Only affects the Working sidebar section. f5 declined that section and keeps SidebarAttentionSection.

suggestion.reason: Only affects the Working sidebar section. f5 declined that section and keeps SidebarAttentionSection.

topics.summary: Re-enables dragging rows out of the Working sidebar section as composer references, while blocking sidebar moves from Working.
topics.title: Working-section threads can be dragged into chat as references

suggestion.reason: Error-clarity improvement for ACP providers. Reimplement in f5's ACP layer.

topics.summary: Invalid-parameter failures at the model-write boundary show a fixed message that names the model and explains how to retry, instead of a generic session-open or turn-start error.
topics.title: ACP model rejections explain the selected model

suggestion.reason: A PR hub UX fix for forges that f5 supports.

topics.summary: Line selection in the PR Code tab no longer depends on permission to post host comments. When comments are not allowed, the draft offers Add to agent as its main action, for example on Azure DevOps.
topics.title: Add to agent works on pull requests the user cannot comment on

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix that prevents thread data from being overwritten. Reimplement it in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: The orchestrator checks the thread projection and rejects thread.create with OrchestratorThreadAlreadyExistsError, so existing threads are not overwritten and deleted ones are not revived. Command retries still replay their receipts.
topics.title: thread.create is rejected for an existing or deleted thread id

suggestion.reason: Adds visible startup feedback on desktop. The product name in the label needs to change for f5.

topics.summary: The connecting splash now appears before any enabled primary backend starts, not only for WSL-only launches. Native launches read 'Starting T3 Code…'.
topics.title: Desktop shows a Starting splash while the local backend starts

suggestion.reason: Stops two servers from sharing one data directory, which can corrupt data. This applies if f5 ships the background service.

topics.summary: At startup, the server checks the installed launchd or systemd service for the same home. If that service is older than 0.1.0, or has a deferred update, startup exits 78 with recovery guidance.
topics.title: Server refuses a T3 home used by an older background service

suggestion.reason: One-line header fix. It applies if f5 has scratch projects.

topics.summary: ChatHeader shows 'No project' for scratch projects instead of the renamed scratch project title.
topics.title: Scratch thread breadcrumbs show No project

suggestion.reason: Fixes a navigation bug in thread routing that can happen in f5.

topics.summary: When a thread is missing from the shell, the route waits on its detail stream before redirecting. Usable detail opens the conversation. Missing, deleted or archived threads still redirect.
topics.title: Opening a just-created thread no longer bounces to the start page

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for the Codex provider.

topics.summary: The Codex JSONL reader counts UTF-8 bytes across fragments and ends the transport above 128 MiB, instead of running the server out of heap.
topics.title: Codex session ends when an incoming message exceeds 128 MiB

suggestion.reason: Agents get accurate preview tool results instead of a silent success on the wrong tab.

topics.summary: An explicit tabId that matches no server tab now returns tab-not-found. A tabId for a desktop tab returns an error explaining that the server browser cannot control it. Before, a new tab was created silently.
topics.title: preview_open rejects an explicit tabId that does not resolve

suggestion.reason: Lowers the resource monitor's memory use on macOS.

topics.summary: macOS uses Linux's two-stage collection. Discovery stays lean, and command lines and memory are loaded only for tracked processes.
topics.title: macOS resource monitor stops retaining unrelated process details

suggestion.reason: Reduces token waste in f5's orchestrator MCP delegation responses.

topics.summary: When latestTerminalSummary and the context-transfer ID match the summary fields exactly, they are set to null. This saves agent context on every task-status check.
topics.title: Delegated task status stops repeating the same result twice

suggestion.reason: Clearer timeline labels.

topics.summary: Fixes awkward work-log labels for unwatch, review-guide and delegated-task cancel tool calls.
topics.title: Unwatch, review guide and task cancel labels read as sentences

suggestion.reason: Small visual fix in a settings surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The Settings → Archive Unarchive button uses the small size instead of extra-small, so the icon no longer crowds its label.
topics.title: Archive panel Unarchive button gets proper icon spacing

suggestion.reason: Clearer provider errors for Cursor. Reimplement in f5's provider layer.

topics.summary: Cursor's plan_required error now appears in provider status and sign-in, explaining that the account needs a paid plan.
topics.title: Cursor status explains when a free-plan account is rejected

suggestion.reason: Prevents surprising data loss in checkpoint rollback.

topics.summary: The confirmation says that reverting files also discards manual edits, and the button uses the destructive-outline style.
topics.title: Edit from here warns that Revert files too undoes your own edits

suggestion.reason: UX fix in chat markdown rendering. f5 has ChatMarkdown.tsx.

topics.summary: MarkdownTable measures the unwrapped layout before paint and hides the expand/collapse cells button unless a cell actually overflows.
topics.title: Table expand button only shows when a cell is cut off

suggestion.reason: Improves observability for the Claude provider. f5 has EventNdjsonLogger.

topics.summary: Native system/thinking_tokens frames are no longer written to the provider event log. They had taken up about 70% of its lines and crowded out protocol history.
topics.title: Provider logs skip Claude thinking-token counter frames

suggestion.reason: Removes a sixfold duplicate directory scan, if f5 has the same PR cache layer.

topics.summary: Cleanup is acquired through a memoized Layer.effectDiscard, so one prune loop runs instead of one per consumer.
topics.title: PR read cache cleanup runs once per shared layer

suggestion.reason: Provider bug fix for Antigravity, which f5 supports. Reimplement in f5's ACP adapter.

topics.summary: When Antigravity reports html_render as a text summary instead of its MCP result, the published page is recovered from a bounded per-thread cache, so the page shows in the thread.
topics.title: Antigravity html_render pages show in the thread

suggestion.reason: Prompt fix for delegation and PR-watch flows, reimplemented in f5's runtime instructions.

topics.summary: Runtime instructions tell delegated children to return PR URLs, head SHA and pending state to the parent instead of trying watches the server rejects.
topics.title: Delegated children report PRs to their parent instead of watching them

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance gain: one fewer git process per status read.

topics.summary: Cached remote-status reads use only the upstream ref and no longer run git remote. Fetch and push resolution are unchanged.
topics.title: Git status reads skip enumerating remotes

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in the Cursor provider's skill discovery. Reimplement it in the fork's provider layer.

topics.summary: The skill scan skips node_modules directories, so installed dependencies no longer use up the 10,000-entry scan budget and leave the $ picker empty.
topics.title: Cursor skill discovery skips node_modules

suggestion.reason: A UX fix in usage, a surface f5 has. It applies if f5 has pooled reset-credit redemption.

topics.summary: While a reset credit is being redeemed, the status line under the pooled usage bar shows 'Using reset credit…' and then the outcome. Before, nothing appeared for several seconds.
topics.title: Usage bar shows reset-credit progress after the popover closes

suggestion.reason: A UX fix in the composer banner stack.

topics.summary: Truncated notice titles use the existing overflow details popover, so a long background command can be read in full.
topics.title: Running banner shows the full command when its title truncates

suggestion.reason: A forge capability f5 can reimplement in its own git layer.

topics.summary: Reads .gitlab/merge_request_templates/Default.md from the base revision, up to 8,000 bytes, when followChangeRequestTemplates is on.
topics.title: GitLab merge request generation follows the repository's default template
fix(mobile): unsent drafts lead the thread list, matching web (#19818)

suggestion.reason: Fixes thread titles in the web send paths. The mobile part does not apply.

topics.summary: Context references are normalized before titles are derived, so t3-context:// markup no longer leaks into temporary titles. Image-only prompts use 'Attached image(s)'. Only the web send paths apply to f5.
topics.title: Threads started with images get readable titles

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance gain in git status, a subsystem f5 has.

topics.summary: Base-branch candidates are now resolved lazily, and a successful origin-default read is reused, which saves git subprocesses during status. The resulting status is unchanged.
topics.title: Git status skips default-branch lookups it doesn't need

suggestion.reason: Improves error messages for the preview browser.

topics.summary: Adds PreviewBrowserRootError for sandbox failures at UID 0, naming the fixes: run as non-root or disable the sandbox. 't3 browser setup' warns about root instead of reporting the host as ready.
topics.title: Preview browser explains Chrome sandbox failures when the server runs as root

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading usage-limit state and stops pointless auto-resume attempts for f5's Claude provider.

topics.summary: blocking_limit counts as a usage limit only when there is rate-limit evidence. Otherwise the turn fails with a context-window-full error that suggests /compact or a new thread.
topics.title: A full Claude context window no longer shows as a usage limit

suggestion.reason: A small visual fix in the timeline, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The +N chip is positioned relative, so it is no longer hidden behind the third subagent avatar.
topics.title: Subagent overflow count paints above the avatar stack

suggestion.reason: Visual fix for composer notice stack if f5 has the equivalent expanded banner stack.

topics.summary: Drops will-change opacity which broke backdrop-filter in Chromium.
topics.title: Expanded composer notices blur the thread behind them

suggestion.reason: Makes provider update detection work for more install layouts. This needs reimplementing in f5's provider maintenance layer.

topics.summary: %LOCALAPPDATA%\vite-plus\bin and ~/.local/share/vite-plus/bin shims are recognized as Vite+ installs, so the Vite+ update command is offered for them.
topics.title: Vite+ provider installs get update prompts on Windows and XDG layouts

suggestion.reason: Fixes Open in for remote file previews.

topics.summary: VS Code-family remote URLs for confirmed files get :1:1 appended, so Remote-SSH opens the file instead of failing with ENOTDIR.
topics.title: Remote file previews open as files in VS Code

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for the PR hub when client and server versions differ.

topics.summary: Response arrays for PR actions, review verdicts, and merge and update methods use ForwardCompatibleArray, so unknown members are dropped instead of failing the whole PR. Mutation inputs stay strict.
topics.title: Older clients still load PRs from newer servers

suggestion.reason: Only applies to projects that span several environments.

topics.summary: The machine picker is limited to drafts, and a static machine label stays on started threads in multi-machine projects.
topics.title: Started threads no longer offer a machine picker that does nothing

suggestion.reason: The Tailscale Serve pairing fix applies to f5. Leave out the T3 Connect tunnel parts.

topics.summary: Tunnel and Serve targets use [::1] when the server listens on IPv6 loopback. pair keeps an explicit non-wildcard host, including localhost.
topics.title: Tailscale Serve and T3 Connect reach servers bound to ::1

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong or clipped agent preview snapshots at common display scales.

topics.summary: Snapshots read the display and viewport metrics and the browser zoom. Reported dimensions come from the PNG header, so the size is right at non-2x scales and after phone resizing.
topics.title: Desktop-drawn preview snapshots match the page's scale and viewport

suggestion.reason: Preview browser fix: agent tabs in unopened threads had no desktop host.

topics.summary: The desktop host finds threads from preview events and mounts per-thread session sync before their chat opens. Preview events are delivered one at a time, so a batch can't hide an open or close.
topics.title: Agent preview tabs in background threads open in the desktop browser

suggestion.reason: A cheap performance fix for the timeline.

topics.summary: Adds decoding="async" to user attachment images, so large images no longer stall the timeline.
topics.title: Timeline image attachments decode asynchronously

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale screenshots in the preview browser, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Each still capture holds its own rendering lease, waits for a bounded paint check plus a discarded warmup capture, then reads back. Hidden or minimized previews no longer return stale pixels or fail.
topics.title: Preview screenshots of hidden or minimized tabs capture fresh pixels

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Codex command stuck as running, which can also happen in f5. Needs reimplementing in f5's Codex adapter because orchestration-v2 doesn't exist here.

topics.summary: thread/closed notifications interrupt the running command items of matching settled turns and clear their tracking. The root outcome stays completed, and late completions can't restore the command.
topics.title: Codex commands stop showing as running when their native thread closes

suggestion.question: Does f5 support Bitbucket Cloud pull requests with settle-on-merge?
suggestion.reason: Forge bug fix that applies if f5 supports Bitbucket and settle-on-merge. Reimplement outside source-control-* packages.

topics.summary: Reads Bitbucket's closed_on (fields=+closed_on) as mergedAt/closedAt so settle-on-merge works. PR sync keeps polling merged snapshots that have no merge time.
topics.title: Bitbucket threads settle after their pull request merges

suggestion.reason: Fixes Grok provider behavior. Reimplement it in f5's ACP layer.

topics.summary: The ACP adapter registers a command when its start is acknowledged and keeps its terminal result until the prompt settles. A sparse duplicate notification no longer overwrites a known failure.
topics.title: Grok background commands that finish before the prompt settles stop showing as running

suggestion.reason: UX improvement in the PR hub, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The Code tab shows a centered error state with a plain-language rate-limit message, Retry and a link to the PR. The raw error moves under collapsed Technical details.
topics.title: Pull request diff load failures show a clear error with retry

suggestion.reason: Prevents an accidental immediate merge in the PR hub. This has to be reimplemented in f5's GitHub layer.

topics.summary: Reads the repo's auto-merge setting and merge state. Auto-merge is withheld when the repo disables it or the PR is CLEAN, HAS_HOOKS or UNSTABLE, so accepting it no longer merges right away.
topics.title: GitHub offers auto-merge only when it would wait

suggestion.reason: Removes false failures from Diagnostics and observability. Only the server and web parts apply.

topics.summary: Optional file reads accept allowMissing and return exists:false, so projects without t3.json no longer log failed read spans in Diagnostics. Real errors still fail, and symlink containment still applies.
topics.title: A missing t3.json is no longer recorded as a failed read

suggestion.reason: Fixes a layout bug on the Usage page.

topics.summary: Pooled usage bars pick account labels by each segment's measured width (224px per segment). Narrower bars use the numbered strip and the legend.
topics.title: Limit bars with many accounts no longer clip names to one letter

suggestion.reason: This is a small composer correctness fix on desktop.

topics.summary: The check for whether a label is attached to the previous word uses an alternation that works around a V8 bug in Electron. The bug turned labels after non-BMP characters into chips.
topics.title: Terminal labels after non-BMP letters stay plain text

suggestion.reason: This only affects device-host commands.

topics.summary: Device-host SSH commands keep the last 4,000 characters of failed stdout after redaction, so the final diagnostic is retained.
topics.title: Failed SSH device commands keep the end of their output

suggestion.reason: Devices panel only.

topics.summary: Caps device host diagnostics height so controls stay visible.
topics.title: Bound long device diagnostics in DevicePanel

suggestion.reason: Changes only the devices and simulators subsystem.

topics.summary: When emulator -list-avds fails, the devices the hub already returned are kept and a host warning is shown.
topics.title: Device inventory survives a failed AVD enumeration

suggestion.reason: Affects only the Devices and simulators surface.

topics.summary: The device chooser, setup wizard and settings show each ready host's discovery warning with the host's label.
topics.title: Ready device hosts show their discovery warnings
fix(mobile): the Android composer no longer lags the keyboard or drops under the nav bar (#19980)

suggestion.reason: Composer bug where drops change the wrong thread's draft.

topics.summary: The drop handlers use useStableCallback instead of useEffectEvent, which React does not refresh on memo fibers. Drops no longer go into the first mounted thread's draft.
topics.title: Dropped thread references land in the visible thread's draft

suggestion.reason: Fixes a race that leaves threads stuck with queued messages, where f5 has delegated tasks.

topics.summary: Finalization reloads the parent run inside the event sink transaction and replaces only delegatedCompletion. A parent that finished during checkpoint capture no longer goes back to waiting or loses its checkpoint.
topics.title: A delegated child finishing no longer reverts its finished parent run
