suggestion.reason: UI bug fix in the thread details card, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Expanded extra PR rows no longer count toward the thread details card's density measurement. Run context and Open in editor stay visible after the list is expanded and collapsed again.
topics.title: Long PR lists no longer hide thread details controls

suggestion.reason: Fixes a startup crash when the default provider is disabled.

topics.summary: Startup catches thread-launch failures when it creates the first thread, logs them, and continues without a bootstrap thread.
topics.title: A disabled bootstrap provider no longer stops server startup

suggestion.reason: Fixes a deadlock in delegated subagent waits. Needs reimplementing in f5's orchestrator MCP layer.

topics.summary: Waiting on a delegated task now returns the oldest live approval request id, kind and run id for that task's run, so parent and child no longer block each other.
topics.title: delegate_task wait returns when the child is waiting for approval

suggestion.reason: Fixes Cursor threads failing to start on Windows.

topics.summary: On Windows, the default sandbox is left out for Auto and Supervised modes with Auto-review, because the SDK has no Windows sandbox. Explicit policies are kept, and a session warning explains the limitation.
topics.title: Default Cursor threads start on Windows
fix(mobile): Android terminal input no longer triggers password autofill (#20051)

suggestion.reason: Fixes child-thread controls that were hidden in f5's composer banner stack.

topics.summary: Background-work descriptions move below the truncated title, child labels wrap, and the banner's scroll area bounds its height. Stop stays aligned with the title.
topics.title: Long background-work banners keep subagent links visible

suggestion.reason: Only affects SSH remote runtime installs in upstream's ssh package, which serves multi-environment hosting.

topics.summary: The remote install lock is created with shell noclobber instead of mkdir, which uutils can report as successful on EEXIST.
topics.title: Concurrent SSH runtime installs no longer race on uutils mkdir

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance gain for long threads. It must be reimplemented if f5 builds bounded snapshots the same way.

topics.summary: When the retained message text alone exceeds the payload budget, building a bounded thread snapshot skips the full JSON encode. The exact size check still decides other cases.
topics.title: Bounded snapshots of threads with large messages skip a full encode

suggestion.reason: Only affects mobile app builds.

topics.summary: mobile-native-client preserves android/.gradle and app/.cxx across expo prebuild --clean.
topics.title: Clean Android dev-client builds keep their Gradle and native caches

suggestion.reason: Fixes runs stuck in preparing after archive. Reimplement in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: Archive cancels a preparing run, its attempt and node, and the Preparing workspace activity, so late callbacks cannot revive the run after the thread is reopened.
topics.title: Archiving a thread cancels runs still preparing the workspace

suggestion.reason: Fixes the missing Antigravity Gemini limits on the usage surface.

topics.summary: The usage probe queries both Cloud Code hosts at the same time and merges their windows by bucket. When both report a bucket, the more-used reading wins, so the Gemini allowance appears.
topics.title: Antigravity usage shows Gemini limits by merging both quota endpoints

suggestion.reason: Fixes a hang in preview browser recording, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Each capturePage warmup attempt gets the one-second capture deadline. A stalled warmup now releases the tab lifecycle lock, so STOP isn't left queued.
topics.title: Preview recording warmup no longer holds the tab lock forever

suggestion.reason: Fixes a timeline scroll jump.

topics.summary: The growth of expanded notices is left out of the timeline inset, so the thread doesn't jump on the next update. Expanded notices cover the last rows.
topics.title: Expanding stacked notices no longer scrolls a working thread

suggestion.reason: Visual fix in provider settings for Antigravity, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: Removes the extra line under the last row and the empty environment-fields wrapper, and squares off nested row separators in the provider setup card.
topics.title: Antigravity setup card separators match other settings cards

suggestion.reason: PR check status can be wrong in f5's forges, such as Forgejo. Reimplement in f5's forge layer.

topics.summary: The check-run deduper compares parsed instants, including fractional seconds and offsets, instead of strings. A newer failure no longer loses to an older success.
topics.title: PR check deduping compares timestamps as instants

suggestion.reason: Fixes a diff panel UX bug in a panel f5 has.

topics.summary: Turn file selections go through the same expand-and-reveal path as the file tree. Sibling expansion choices are kept, and refreshes don't replay an earlier selection.
topics.title: Clicking a file in a turn expands it in the diff panel

suggestion.reason: Makes opening forked threads faster. It has to be reimplemented in f5's projection store.

topics.summary: An initial read of a fork counts the parent's retained rows instead of loading and decoding inherited tool output that would be thrown away. Item positions and cursors stay the same.
topics.title: Forked threads load faster when their own turns fill the first page
fix(mobile): fresh Android builds no longer crash on launch (#20118)

suggestion.reason: A measurable speedup in branch switching with no behavior change.

topics.summary: switchRef skips the tracking-branch scan when the selected local ref exists, and skips the derived-name probe once a tracker is found. This means fewer git processes per checkout.
topics.title: Branch switching skips unused Git probes

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing skills for the Claude provider, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Skill discovery parses --add-dir from the instance's launch args and scans <dir>/.claude/skills, so those skills appear in the $ picker and / menu and $name rewrites work.
topics.title: Claude skill discovery includes --add-dir directories from launch args

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong paths and failed selective commits in f5's git integration.

topics.summary: Git status and numstat are parsed from NUL-delimited output, and selective staging uses literal top-level pathspecs. Local status returns the repo root, so file actions work in nested projects.
topics.title: Changed files keep their real paths for renames and non-ASCII names

suggestion.reason: Only fixes the provider-handoff budget, a context-handoff subsystem f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Adds an ACP flavor hook so the Grok adapter reports the model's totalContextTokens. Switching back to Grok no longer fails with insufficient context allowance for the provider handoff.
topics.title: Grok reports model context windows for handoff budgets

topics.reason: This only affects the Device panel and simulators.

suggestion.reason: This only affects the Device panel and simulators.

topics.summary: Before rotating, the server reads adb wm size and remaps rotations for landscape-native Android devices.

suggestion.reason: Stops the composer from rewriting pasted code. Apply it to f5's mention tokenizer.

topics.title: Pasted decorator calls like @foo(bar) stay as text instead of becoming file chips

suggestion.reason: Fixes broken input after a shell restart in the terminal.

topics.title: Preview annotation editor shows its borders and shadows again

suggestion.reason: A one-prop fix for a settings UX bug.
